fascinating-lecture-3-4.descripcion: The semitransparent image of a small Garundi woman at the podium suddenly begins lecturing on the nature of enchantment magic.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 20 to disrupt the lecture, Thievery DC 23 (trained) to scratch out of one of the glyphs on the podium, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract one of the runes; three total successes are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) (arcane, compulsion, enchantment, mental, nonlethal) The image lectures on incredibly advanced topics without pause, overwhelming the minds of those listening while compelling them to continue to pay attention. Each creature in the room must succeed at a Will DC 22 save and take 2d6 nonlethal mental damage, as well as the following effects.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Stunned 1 and takes half damage as it shakes off most of the mental load.

Failure The creature is Stunned 2 and takes full damage as it can't help but try and process all the information.

Critical Failure The creature is stunned for 1 round, Fascinated for 1 minute, and takes double damage as all its mental faculties are focused on the lecture. Damage from this hazard does not end the fascinated condition. A creature who is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the fascinating lecture enters a catatonic stupor until they regain Hit Points. If a creature spends 1 hour in the stupor, they automatically regain 1 Hit Point and awaken.

fast-spinning-juice-fountain.descripcion: The enchanted fountain spews large quantities of grape juice as its marble tiers spin with increasing speed, flinging juice in all directions.

datos.desactivar:
Athletics DC 20 to Grapple a tier and halt its momentum, followed by Crafting DC 18 or Thievery DC 18 (while the tier is grabbed) to disable the pump mechanism through the gap that the previous checks left open. Grappling a tier requires 1 action. Each Crafting or Thievery check to disable a tier is a 2-action activity.

The fountain has three tiers, and fully disabling the fountain requires each tier to be disabled. For each disabled tier, the DC's to Grapple or disable another tier decrease by 2. If the creature critically succeeds at a check to disable a tier, it's immediately disabled, regardless of the number of checks that would otherwise be required due to Challenge Point adjustments.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The fountain accelerates its spinning, spraying juice 10 feet in all directions on its first turn, 15 feet in all directions on its second turn, and 20 feet in all directions on its third turn. Every square where it sprays juice becomes difficult terrain. At the start of its fourth turn, the fountain breaks, disabling the hazard and flinging juice 25 feet in all directions.

fiendish-reflection.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
fiendish-reflection.descripcion: Reflections viewed in the water here appear monstrous and fiendish; a PC who views themself in these waters sees a distorted version of themself looking back at them, sneering and mocking.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 to exorcise the haunt, or Intimidation DC 23 to turn the fear back on the haunt and overwhelm it with its own terror
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets at the end of the round automatically, ready to trigger again the next tome someone looks into the water.

firespark-trap-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
firespark-trap-3-4.descripcion: Magical motion sensors detect when a creature enters the chamber.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disable the sensor without triggering them, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the sensors

flames-of-verakivhan-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-18: The Fanciful March of Urwal
flames-of-verakivhan-5-6.descripcion: The demon lord Urxehl manifests upon Golarion a small region of his Abyssal realm, filled with constantly burning forests lashed by fierce storms and unholy rain that only further feeds the flames. This is a mystical fire, fueled by the presence of Urxehl's minions. Any flames on the map emit concealing smoke in a 10-foot radius around the fire.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 20 or Performance DC 20 (trained) to remind the Finadar forest of its true self; or Religion DC 20, Occultism DC 20, or Demon Lore(trained) to disrupt the connection to the imposed realm and extinguish one of the five sections of flames on the map. These checks can only be attempted by creatures adjacent to the section, and each attempt takes 2 actions. An extinguished fire still emits concealing smoke for 1 additional round but is no longer hot enough to deal damage. A Dispel Magic spell or a spell with the water trait (2nd level; counteract DC 17) extinguishes a section of flames. If the PCs disable three of the five sections of the flames of Verakivhan, the hazard is too weakened to sustain itself, and the remaining flames disappear. If there are no demons or elementals remaining in the area, the hazard is automatically disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Any creature within the flames takes 1d10+6 fire damage, and any creature adjacent to the flames takes 1d10 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 20). Additionally, the flames call down a fiery rain that deals 1d10+6 fire damage to a random PC within the planar overlay (basic Reflex DC 20 save). If any PCs attempted to disable the hazard that turn, the fiery rain chooses one of them as its target.

flaming-sphere-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 5-foot radius.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (2rd rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the rune

flaming-sphere-rune-5-6.descripcion: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 5-foot radius.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (trained) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (2rd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the rune

foretold-ruin-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-21: In Pursuit of Water
foretold-ruin-3-4.descripcion: Daemonic curses slither and crawl through malevolent runes carved in four stone pillars. HP is per-pillar.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to scratch out a pillar's runes, Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract a pillar's magic, or Athletics (Force Open) to push a pillar over. Disabling a pillar requires two actions. Disabling all four pillars or slaying Sezruth disables the trap
datos.rutina:
Routine (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled pillar. On its initiative, the trap uses each action to afflict a different non-evil creature in the room with thirst. The creature must attempt a Fortitude DC 20 save.

—

Critical Success The creature is temporarily immune to additional negative effects from the foretold ruin hazard's reaction for 24 hours. The hazard has no awareness of this immunity and continues to target this creature.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Fatigued until they drink water. If the creature was already fatigued, they take 1d6 nonlethal mental damage.

Critical Failure The creature is fatigued until they drink water and takes 1d6 nonlethal mental damage. If the creature was already fatigued, they instead take 2d6 nonlethal mental damage.

foul-font.descripcion: The font is hidden just under the water's surface. It spews foul brown sludge into the pristine waters, leaving them reeking and polluted as they move downstream. It can be reached without swimming, but not without getting wet.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 17 (trained) to draw upon the suppressed Primal energies of this place to cleanse the font, Religion DC 23 (expert) to suppress the void energies, Thievery DC 20 to undo the magic sigils allowing the font to operate; two total successes are required to disable the font.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The foul font uses its actions each turn to spew a single void geyser.
datos.reinicio: The foul font deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

grasping-currents.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
grasping-currents.descripcion: A swath of drowned spirits tries to pull someone down into the water to join them.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 to calm the unquiet spirits in the waters for an hour, or light the Eternal Lantern (automatically disables the haunt)
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the grasping currents attempt to Grapple a swimming creature or capsize a rowboat by attempting an Athletics check with a +12 modifier. A creature that's Restrained by the grasping currents is pulled underwater and risks drowning. To capsize a rowboat, the haunt's Athletics check is rolled against the pilot's Athletics or Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.
datos.reinicio: The grasping currents quickly build up power and can trigger again after 10 minutes have passed.

grasping-limbs-5-6.descripcion: The limbs of smashed constructs line the bottom of the fissure, beneath the water. They desperately grab anything that gets too close.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (trained) or Engineering Lore or Azlant Lore twice to immobilize the limbs, or Deception twice to trick the limbs into grasping each other.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The grasping limbs try to Grapple all creatures in the water (Athletics +12). They then tighten around all creatures they have grabbed or restrained, dealing 2d8 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 20).

grazing-deer.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: A Fistful of Flowers
grazing-deer.descripcion: A herd of deer exits the woods to investigate the delicious-looking leshys.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy (with Wild Empathy) to befriend the deer and convince them that leshys aren't for nibbling, or Intimidation to scare away the deer.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The grazing deer takes one action to move about, and then one action to eagerly nibble at a randomly chosen PC. A character who spends three actions on their turn to Stride can avoid being nibbled by the grazing deer during the hazard's next turn. If all of the PCs do so, attempt a Flat DC 5-on a success, the party escapes the deer and can proceed onward to Petalbrook, but they become delayed as a result of having to flee the pack of ravenous deer.

grove-of-despair.descripcion: An eerie fog fills a lonely stretch of forest.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 22 (untrained) to Request that the spirits leave or Religion DC 20 (trained) to exorcise the spirits. All creatures and objects within the fog are Concealed, and all creatures and objects outside the fog are concealed to creatures within it.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; auditory, emotion, fear, mental) The haunt attempts an Intimidation check with a {+12} modifier against the Will DC of each Frightened creature as it fills their minds with haunting whispers.

—
Critical Success The creature takes 4d6 mental damage and its frightened condition increases by 1, to a maximum of Frightened 3.
Success The creature takes 2d6 mental damage.
Failure The creature is unaffected.
Critical Failure The creature's frightened condition is reduced by 1.
datos.reinicio: The haunt falls silent for 24 hours once all frightened creatures die or reduce their frightened condition's value to 0. During this time, a creature that isn't frightened can exorcise the spirits with a Religion DC 20 check, permanently destroying the haunt.

hallways-full-of-mostly-illusory-opossum.nombre: Hallways Full of Mostly Illusory Opossums
hallways-full-of-mostly-illusory-opossum.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-16: Dacilane Academy's First Great Prank War
hallways-full-of-mostly-illusory-opossum.descripcion: Several distressed opossums dressed in school uniforms and under the effects of Mirror Image fly about the hallway, guided by four giggling sprites.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 20, Deception DC 20, or Intimidation DC 20 four times to convince one sprite to undo their spells; Athletics DC 22, Diplomacy DC 22 (with wild empathy) or Nature DC 22 to subdue or soothe the opossums; or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to undo one sprites' worth of spells. Four successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The hazard loses 1 action each turn for each Disable success. Each sprite takes one action to Strike a different randomly chosen PC.

haunted-hollows.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-99: Under the Eye of the Mantis
haunted-hollows.descripcion: The spirits of innumerable dryads and peaceful wood elementals, ripped from their bodies as they were turned into furniture, writhe and seethe, lashing out at both living and undead alike.

datos.desactivar:
Diplomacy DC 17 (trained), Nature DC 17 (trained), or Religion DC 17 (trained) to set the spirits to rest or Deception DC 20, Intimidation DC 20, or Occultism DC 20 to convince the spirits that their eternal rest is coming soon.
A PC may make a Strike against AC 16 to destroy a single table or chair in the room, this functions as a successful check to Aid another PC attempting to disable the haunt; two total successes are required to disable the haunt. If all of the tables and chairs are destroyed, the haunt is temporarily disabled until dawn of the next day.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The Haunted Hollows haunt uses one table flip Strike or two chair toss Strikes at random creatures in the area, favoring those who are trying to disable the haunt first. The table flip Strikes originate with any table in the room, destroying the table in the process. The chair toss Strikes originate with any chair or bar stool in the room, destroying that object in the process. If the haunt is not disabled, these objects reform and return to their original positions at dawn of the next day.

hero-god-s-rage.descripcion: Sophreista's ghost glows red, and shrieking in fury, she flies at her opponents.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 18 (trained) to subdue the spirit, Religion DC 18 to calm the spirit, Deception DC 16 or Diplomacy DC 16 to talk the spirit down; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action) Sophreista lashes out at the nearest living creature, dealing 1d10+6 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 20 save) and binding their fate to hers; a creature that critically fails their save is Doomed 1 (maximum Doomed 3).

hexed-chest.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers
hexed-chest.descripcion: The magical runes glow at any attempt to open this chest.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 19 (trained) to safely scratch out the runes or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 17) to counteract the runes.

hidden-chute.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
hidden-chute.descripcion: A trapdoor in the floor conceals a stone chute.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to remove the trapdoor or lock it in position using a catch hidden inside the room's doorframe

hot-oven.descripcion: This fiery hot oven needs to be extra-large to keep up with the demands of the bakery—large enough for a Medium creature to crawl inside. Or be pushed.

datos.desactivar: 1 Interact action and a Athletics DC 18 check to close the oven door after it's been opened.
datos.reinicio: The oven door can be opened and closed freely, as described above, for the course of the entire combat. If left to its own devices, the oven burns through its fuel and goes out roughly 1 hour after it's lit.

house-spirits-with-a-large-number-of-reg.nombre: House Spirits With a Large Number of Regenerating Pies
house-spirits-with-a-large-number-of-reg.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-16: Dacilane Academy's First Great Prank War
house-spirits-with-a-large-number-of-reg.descripcion: A group of house spirits run around the lunchroom hurling pies at the walls and all the people in the room—and then the pies magically reconstitute and throw themselves again.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 20, Deception DC 20, or Intimidation DC 20 four times to convince the spirits to undo their spells, Arcana DC 18 or Occultism DC 21 to unravel a pie's enchantments, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to undo one pies' worth of spells. Three successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The hazard regenerates any pies that it has thrown at a cost of one action per pie (to a maximum of 3 active pies). Each successful check to disable the hazard deactivates one of the pies, reducing the number of active pies by 1. After regenerating pies on its turn, the hazard throws pies whenever a creature triggers continually sur-piesed. For each pie Strike, roll 1d4. On a 1, the pie pan has nails driven into it by Numblekin and deals an additional 1d10+6 piercing damage. The nails make the pie's damage lethal, rather than nonlethal.

in-a-pickle.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-01: Intro to the Year of Battle's Spark: Enough is Enough
in-a-pickle.descripcion: A soot-blackened brazier glows with fiendish light, shadows fickering inside.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 18, Occultism DC 18, or Religion DC 18 while within 15 feet of the brazier to command it to stop, reducing its actions by 1 (or 2 on a critical success); Thievery DC 20 to fnd the hidden switch on the brazier that deactivates it; or 1st-rank spell, counteract DC 17, to dispel the shadow flames in one square, using any spell with the water or light traits.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap ignites shadowy flames in a 5-foot square within the area of the room A creature that moves into or ends its turn in this fire takes 1d6+5 fire damage (basic Fortitude DC 17) Increase the DC by 2 if the creature is in magical darkness (basic Fortitude DC 19).
datos.reinicio: The flames cease 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area, but after 1 hour, a well of darkness fills the brazier and it is ready to trigger again.

jury-rigged-annihilator.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall
jury-rigged-annihilator.descripcion:
A gargantuan scorpion-like robot, covered in signs of damage, has been bolted into the canyon's rock walls.

—

Integrated Chain Gun Hardness 10, HP 40 (BT 20) per integrated chain gun

Plasma Lance Hardness 10, Plasma Lance HP 20 (BT 10)

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to successfully disable the annihilator at the control box on the northwest ledge, Thievery DC 20 (trained) or Engineering-lore DC 15 (trained) to jam the mechanics of either of the two chain guns, or the "tail" mechanism where the plasma lance is mounted, preventing it from firing. Jamming the guns or tail requires first getting on top of the Immobilized annihilator, which counts as difficult terrain. All attempts take 2 actions.
datos.rutina: (2 Actions) When the plasma lance is ready, the annihilator uses it to attack as many PCs as it can, otherwise it attacks with its two integrated chain guns while the plasma lance recharges, spending one action for each of its two integrated chain guns that is still functional. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty. If Synthetic Khismar is destroyed, the annihilator attacks as many creatures as possible.

kepgeda-s-keening-cauldron.descripcion: The cauldron's ear-splitting keening calls forth spectral claws to assail ears and souls alike.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 22 to tip the cauldron, or Occultism DC 20 or Religion DC 20 (trained) to ward against the cauldron's effects. Any combination of three successful attempts is required to fully disable the haunt. When the haunt is disabled, the coven seeks vengeance.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The spectral hands scurry about, grabbing at all of Kepgeda's foes in area E13. Each such creature takes 3d6 mental damage (basic Will DC 20) as the spectral claws assail them. A creature that takes mental damage from this effect doesn't reduce their frightened value at the end of their next turn.
datos.reinicio: The haunt becomes inert (resuming its usual screaming) at the end of any round in which no creatures other than Kepgeda remain in her kitchen.

lacerating-trip-wire.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
lacerating-trip-wire.descripcion: Barbed wire stretches across the passageway at the perfect height to tear into ankles.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to detach the wire

lightning-platform-5-6.descripcion: A magnetically charged platform draws in armored creatures, then flings them up into the sky, where they are struck by lightning.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to ground out the energy or Arcana DC 23 (trained) to neutralize the magical charge

lightning-strikes-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need
lightning-strikes-3-4.descripcion: The air grows thick as the Planes of Metal and Air both bleed into the swamp once again. A small fissure opens, causing static electricity to build and, fueled by the increased presence of metal in the area, sparks begin to fly. Electrical discharges begin to break out reaching from objects to unlucky creatures.

datos.desactivar: Arcana,nature,thievery DC 18 (trained) three times to counter the planar energies.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) On its turn each round, the electrical discharge randomly targets two creatures dealing 3d4 electricity damage. A targeted creature must attempt a basic Reflex DC 18 save.

littler-beasts.descripcion: At first, the tree looks small. Then the space around it warps to give the impression that it's a normal-sized tree seen at a distance.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 20 or Occultism DC 20 twice to disperse the warped magic around the tree, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 19) to counteract the warped magic
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The trap targets a random creature within 60 feet to try to bring it down to its size. That creature must attempt a Will DC 20 save. On a failure, the creature becomes Tiny in size until the beginning of its next turn. An affected creature's equipment shrinks with it but returns to its original size if removed. The creature's reach changes to 0 feet. This is a polymorph effect that has no effect on a Tiny creature. On a critical failure, the creature is also Enfeebled 2 for the same duration.
Effect: Littler
datos.reinicio: If the trap isn't disabled, it becomes dormant for 10 minutes if there are no creatures within 60 feet of it at the start of its turn.

lonely-machine-spirit.fuente: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
lonely-machine-spirit.descripcion: Ghostly smoke rising from an alchemical engine belches forth; the screeching sound of grinding gears echoes from the engine as it shutters to life.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 22 (trained) or Engineering DC 20 Lore (trained) to eject the animating spirit from its mechanical shell. Creatures gain a +2 circumstance bonus on their check if they use the airship's name, Harpy's Kiss, as part of their skill check, or a +4 circumstance bonus if they utter the name "Phera Wyndslow." The haunt remains active until its spirit is ejected, the haunt is destroyed, or there are no living creatures within 30 feet.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The lonely machine spirit Belches Smoke or makes two red hot gear Strikes against two creatures within 30 feet.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates and resets after 1 hour.

loose-slab.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
loose-slab.descripcion: The stone slab tears free from its track with the ear-piercing sound of failing metal.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 20 (expert) to shore up the track so that it functions as intended, or Thievery DC 18 (trained) to wedge the slab in place to immobilize it

malfunctioning-tidal-controls.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
malfunctioning-tidal-controls.descripcion: Sigils carved into the turquoise sphere atop the altar illuminate. Moments later, a rush of water flows into the hallway.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 20 (trained) to neutralize the tidal magic, or Survival DC 23 to predict the changing tides, or Thievery DC 23 (trained) to scratch away the sigils; two total successes are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The magic controlling the tides malfunctions, causing the tides to change every few seconds. Water flows rapidly between areas B2 and B4. Each creature in area B2, area B4, or the hallway connecting them must attempt a Fortitude DC 20 save as the shifting tides buffet them, dealing 2d8 bludgeoning damage.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 10 feet along with the water.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 20 feet along with the water.

malicious-spirits.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-06: Lost on the Spirit Road
malicious-spirits.descripcion: A cadre of evil spirits assails people's minds throughout the stretch of forest. The spirits first afflict their hosts with visceral images of their own deaths, then try to recreate their deaths by forcing their hosts to inflict similar wounds upon themselves. Creatures frightened by the haunt appear to have ephemeral masks with horns, tusks, and yellow eyes over their faces.

datos.desactivar: Two Occultism DC 23 or Religion DC 23 (trained) to exorcise the spirits. A creature can either inflict 4 mental damage to the haunt or permanently lower the DC of checks to exorcise the spirits 1 by succeeding at a Diplomacy DC 20 check to calm the spirits, a Nature DC 20 check to use kami-specific warding incantations, a Occultism DC 20 check to leverage obscure haunt lore, or a Religion DC 20 check to use a lesser exorcism. Any creature currently frightened by the haunt is a potential target for inflicting damage to the haunt; mental and vitality damage only affect such a host creature if they choose to be affected, while force or similar damage harms both the haunt and the host equally.
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) On its initiative, the haunt uses its first two actions to attempt to terrify a random target in its area that is not already Frightened. The target must attempt a Will DC 20 save.

—

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to this haunt for 24 hours.

Success The target is Frightened 1.

Failure The target is frightened 1. The value of the frightened condition does not automatically decrease by 1 at the end of each of the target's turns. Instead, the target can attempt a Will DC 18 save at the end of each of their turns to remove the condition.

Critical Failure The target is Frightened 2. The value of the frightened condition does not automatically decrease by 1 at the end of each of the target's turns. Instead, the target can attempt a Will DC 18 save at the end of each of their turns to lower their frightened value by 1.

—

The haunt then spends an action to compels one of the creatures that it has frightened to harm itself with surrounding forest debris, its strength fueled by spirit possession. The creature must succeed at a Will DC 20 save or attempt to Strike itself during its turn as its first action, using the haunt's statistics below. Note that frightened applies equally to the creature's attack roll and AC, and therefore does not affect the accuracy of the attack.

datos.desactivar:
Thievery DC 20 on each corner mechanism (must disable all three working corners to disable the trap)

Each corner mechanism has hardness 8 and 15 HP
datos.rutina:
Each turn, the fountain uses 1 action. Roll a  and look up the result on the following list to determine which action it uses that round.
• 1-4 Single Target The statue spins about and sprays water at a single random target in the room. Roll a  and count to the number you rolled, starting with the player on your left, to determine which hero gets attacked. The spray is a ranged Strike.
• 5-7 Corner Spray The statue spins about, firing a spray of water at each corner of the room that still has a functioning corner mechanism. This hits any creature adjacent to the corner mechanism, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage. Each hero must attempt a basic Reflex DC 15, taking no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, full damage on a failure, and double damage on a critical failure.
• 8-9 Half Room The statue spins about, spraying half of the room with water. Roll any die. If the result is even, it sprays the west half; otherwise, it sprays the east half. This deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage to each creature in that half of the room, and each hero must attempt a basic Reflex DC 15 save.
• 10 Full Room This works just like the half-room attack, but it targets everyone in the room.

mindhammer-mushrooms.descripcion: The mushrooms emit powerful psychic blasts that overwhelm potential predators with exhausting psychedelic visions.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) to navigate a safe path without triggering the mushrooms
datos.reinicio: The mushrooms must rest for 24 hours before they can emit another Psychic Blast.

moldy-foodstuffs-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave
moldy-foodstuffs-1-2.descripcion: A mold cloud puffs from spoiled spilled food.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 14 (trained) to remove the mold from the food without triggering the spores.

muesello-s-summoning-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-11: No Time for Treason
muesello-s-summoning-rune.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 18 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 20 (trained) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

nether-rift.descripcion: A chill wind blows from a fissure in the cavern wall.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 18, Nature DC 18, Occultism DC 18, or Religion DC 18 (trained) to seal the rift, three successes total; or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 17)
datos.rutina:
(2 actions) The hazard uses its first action to repeat its Wind from the Netherworld reaction. If any patch of barrow claw remains, one of the patches chosen by the GM releases a cloud of spores. The spores fill the barrow claw's space and last until the beginning of the hazard's next turn. Creatures within the spores become Concealed, and all creature outside the spores become concealed to creatures within it.
A creature that enters the spores or starts their turn in the area takes 1d6 persistent damage until they brush off the spores as an Interact action.
datos.reinicio: The rift reopens after  years. Killing the Path River Peeler permanently seals the rift.

old-murder-holes.descripcion: Several dozen spear holes line the sides of the cavern walls, triggered by a false stone in the partially paved surface of the cavern floor. However, most of the spears used to arm the trap are broken and long forgotten on the dusty cavern floor.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to deactivate the trigger on the floor, or Athletics DC 23 to pry up the floor plate to dislodge it from the trigger.

overloading-arch-1-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
overloading-arch-1-2.descripcion: The Eternity Arch sparks with electricity, releasing bolts of lightning at each of the four largest time rifts.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) or Arcana DC 18, Nature DC 18, Occultism DC 18, or Religion DC 18 (trained) to seal each of the four time rifts, Crafting DC 20 (trained) to divert the lightning to another source, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 17) to counteract each time rift. Each attempt requires 2 actions. Skill checks to disable a time rift must attempted from adjacent to the rift.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled time rift. On each of the trap's actions, the Eternity Arch releases a bolt of lightning that activates that rift, dealing 2d6 electricity damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the time rift (basic Reflex DC 20 save). It can release a bolt at each active time rift no more than once each turn.

pendulum-blades.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
pendulum-blades.descripcion: Several swinging pendulums mounted with razor-sharp blades extend from the ceiling and slice into the room below.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 to jam the gears and prevent the trap from being activated

phantom-jailer.descripcion: A spirit appears and arrests the creature by clamping manacles around their wrists.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 18 to seize the manacles from the spirit, Intimidation DC 19 (trained) to order the spirit to stand down, or Occultism DC 20 to exorcise the spirit
datos.reinicio: 1 day

play-time.descripcion: An old, dusty toy box creaks open and forcefully expels a series of cracked and broken toys.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 19 (trained) to exorcise the spirits of the toy box, Athletics DC 20 (trained) to hold the toy box closed momentarily, or Diplomacy DC 21 (trained) to convince the spirits that play time is over; three total success are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action) The toy box belches forth a 15-foot cone of toys, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (chosen randomly each time) with a basic Reflex DC 20 save.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the room or if the toy box is destroyed. After 1 hour, if the toy box remains, the haunt reactivates. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area D5 is destroyed.

plunger-chute.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
plunger-chute.descripcion: A trapdoor in the floor conceals a hidden chute, and a moving section of wall shoves victims into it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to jam the trapdoor shut or activate a hidden bypass switch by twisting a fitting on the gas lamp

poisoned-dart-trap-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
poisoned-dart-trap-3-4.descripcion: Magical motion sensors detect when a creature enters the chamber.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) to disable the pressure plate
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 2 rounds. After 5 total attacks, it runs out of poisoned darts.

precarious-bone-pile.descripcion: This ancient pile of bones appears stable, but the slightest disturbance topples them.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 20 (trained) or Stealth DC 20 (trained) to shimmy past the bones without disturbing them, or deal any amount of damage to trigger the collapse from a distance

pressurized-bottle-3-4.descripcion: One of the potions has decayed, putting it under immense pressure. Its contents have become poisonous. When handled improperly, the bottle bursts, sending glass shards flying everywhere.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to carefully place the bottle under a bucket or bowl.

purple-dye-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
purple-dye-trap.descripcion: A spring-loaded glass jar containing purple dye and a thunderstone pops from the ground and explodes when a pressure sensor is triggered.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to remove the jar and thunderstone carefully or Athletics DC 20 to reinforce the flagstone pressure sensor with an improvised wedge

raging-debris-storm.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-02: The East Hill Haunting
raging-debris-storm.descripcion: Magical sensors detect when a creature enters the chamber.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 21 to convince the spirit to calm the winds, Athletics DC 19 to raise up a wooden bench to block the wind, or Religion DC 19 to speak an appropriate rite to calm the spirit. Two successful checks are required to fully disable the haunt, and each attempt takes two actions. Each successful check removes one action from the haunt.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The haunt uses its first action to stir up a storm of debris against all creatures in the quadrant clockwise from where it last attacked. Creatures in the quadrant take 2d4+4 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 18). For each additional action it has (at most 1 without adjustments from the scaling sidebar), the storm targets an additional quadrant, moving clockwise around the area. On the first round, it begins by attacking creatures in the northwestern quadrant.
datos.reinicio: The storm continues raging for 1 minute unless disabled, and then dissipates, returning after 1 week.

rock-launcher.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
rock-launcher.descripcion: A miniature makeshift catapult launches rocks when a creature triggers the trip wire.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 19 (trained) to disable the catapult without triggering the trap

rockslide-trap.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-10: Delve the Pallid Depths
rockslide-trap.descripcion: The unstable rocks on the floor shift when stepped on, triggering rocks in the pile above to fall down across the pathway.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) to navigate a save path or Thievery DC 20 (trained) to bolster the rocks on the floor so they don't shift under a creature's weight. Two successful checks are necessary to ensure the route through the precarious pile of rocks is safe. Attempting each check requires two actions.

rope-pull.descripcion: This trap appears to be an obvious 10-foot-deep pit with angled walls to prevent easy escape, but the true danger is represented not by the hole in the ground but from a set of loose stones in the ceiling. A knotted rope hangs from a beam above, seemingly to provide an option to swing across the pit, but any weight on the rope pulls down large, heavy boulders stacked far above.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to tie off the rope to a more solid support

rushing-waters.descripcion: Rivulets of water begin to run from the circle of stones to gather in a growing puddle at the center.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (expert) to rub out the hidden runes on the ceiling, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank, counteract DC 18) to counteract the trap
datos.reinicio: The magic rejuvenates over 10 minutes, after which it is recharged and ready to activate again.

rusty-spike-launcher.descripcion: As the large rusty door swings open, a mass of rusty spikes appear out of nowhere in the open doorway and launch violently into the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 to decouple the triggering rods that cause the spikes to extend, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the trap
datos.reinicio: The trap automatically resets once the door is closed.

sacred-geyser.descripcion: A geyser of boiling water erupts at any character who attempts to take water from the oasis.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (trained) to concoct a mechanism for indirectly harvesting the water from a safe distance
datos.reinicio: The geyser resets automatically and adapts to previous circumvention, requiring a new check to disable it each time.

sailor-s-warning-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
sailor-s-warning-3-4.descripcion: An illusory cyclops in oracular robes cries out a warning, but then dissolves into a violent phantasmal cyclops, which calls out for the Blind Formless Chaos That Lies Behind the Stars to accept his sacrifice. It then plunges an obsidian athame into a creature's chest, summoning a foul entity.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 18 (trained) to repair Chamenaiti's magic, Religion DC 20 or Occultism DC 20 (trained) to offset the prayer, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the warning
datos.rutina: a Rubbery crimson tentacles appear from a rip in the air and grasp at all creatures in the area, dealing 1d8 bludgeoning,1d8 acid damage (basic Fortitude DC 20 save).

sapping-slumber.descripcion: Ritual circles barely anchor the ancient stasis magic, which dissipates erratically when disturbed.

datos.desactivar: Hero-God Lore or Occultism DC 16 to convince the magic that it's fulfilled its objective; Arcana DC 18, Nature DC 18, or Religion DC 18 short-circuit the stasis magic; or Thievery DC 20 to disable the ritual circles.

shadow-cannon.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-08: Battle for Star's Fate
shadow-cannon.descripcion: A cannon built of cast iron and infused with shadow magic, mounted on the side of Aslynn's flying ship.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 20 or Thievery DC 20 on the cannon's body to deactivate
datos.rutina: (1 action) The cannon fires a blast that contains as many PCs as possible, choosing randomly in the event of a tie.

shaitan-tactics-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
shaitan-tactics-5-6.descripcion: The shaitan observes the area from a distance, observing the battlefield as a game board. The ground trembles in response to the genie's enthusiasm.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 23 (trained) or Nature DC 23 (trained) to contest the shaitan's control (requires two successes). Each success removes one of the traps actions.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) On each of the trap's actions, the trap either moves a willing creature on the ground up to 30 feet without provoking reactions or makes a hostile creature on the ground Off-Guard for 1 round (Acrobatics DC 23 check or Reflex DC 23 save negates).
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets once all hostile creatures leave A3 or surrender.

shooting-sphere.descripcion: A gilded armillary sphere spins in place, shooting jeweled stars and planets at intruders.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (expert) to disable the sphere from rotating or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 20) to remove the enchantment.
datos.rutina: (1 action) A jeweled planet shoots from the sphere, targeting a random creature within 30 feet. The creature takes 1d10+6 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 20 save).
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature moving within range of its sensor.

sickle-blade.descripcion: A skeletal arm holding a sickle is concealed in the ceiling and connected to a mechanism in the sliding door below it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) on the door frame or ceiling groove, or Interact to operate a lever on the opposite side of the door (in areas D2 and D4, respectively)
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 15 minutes. Additionally, a creature can manually Interact with the lever on the opposite side of the door to reset the trap.

singe-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
singe-3-4.descripcion: Singe's spirit lingers in the Whippoorwill's crow's nest, where it calls out warnings and shoots intruders.

datos.desactivar: Pathfinder-society-lore DC 20 (trained) to persuade Singe that you are Pathfinders or Religion DC 20(trained) to perform rites to lay Singe to rest; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: d Singe uses its first action(s) to make a long gun Strike against a random creature in the area. It uses its final action for Lookout's Warning. If the PCs successfully use Pathfinder Society Lore to Disable the haunt, Singe loses an action to make a long gun Strike.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

sliding-floor.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
sliding-floor.descripcion: The floor wobbles with each step.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 to prop up the floor, or Crafting DC 20 (trained) to reinforce subflooring
datos.reinicio: immediate

sliding-statue-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-09: The Seven Secrets of Dacilane Academy
sliding-statue-3-4.descripcion: With a rumble, this statue of a former Pathfinder slides across the schoolyard. Its legs pump up and down as it advances.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 23 to hold it back, Crafting DC 20 (trained) to break the statue by exploiting a flaw, Occultism DC 18 (trained) to dispel the planar energies.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap uses its three actions for its Trample activity.

sorrowful-tombstone-door.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
sorrowful-tombstone-door.descripcion: A malfunction in the door's opening mechanism has caused unstable magic to pool within it, making it liable to release the sorrows it has collected from all who have mourned their lost homeland at its threshold.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) or Deception DC 23 to coax the door's magic into allowing access; the DC is reduced by 2 if someone in the room has said "Tar Khadurrm" in the last hour.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

spiders-hunting-pit.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
spiders-hunting-pit.descripcion: Loose debris covers a patch of what appears as solid ground in a 10 feet by 5 feet area. It's actually covering thin webbing strung over a 20 foot pit.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to deconstruct the webbing or Acrobatics DC 20 to pull the webbing apart without getting trapped or hit by rocks.
datos.reinicio: 1 week

spiky-pit-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales
spiky-pit-3-4.descripcion: A wooden trapdoor covers a pit that's 10 feet square and 20 feet deep.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 12 to remove the trapdoor
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

spite-of-the-righteous.fuente: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
spite-of-the-righteous.descripcion: The image of a ghostly warrior her holy symbol dripping blood and pulsing with negative energy, steps from the wall and seeks to kill any living creature.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) to exorcise the spirit, Religion DC 21 or Occultism DC 21 (trained) to sever the connection between Hunger's Call and the temple, or Thievery DC 21 (trained) to scratch the eyes out of the mural; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The warrior's blade sweeps through the bodies of any living creature within sight of the exit stairs, and they each take 1d10+4 slashing damage (basic Fortitude DC 20 save). Undead creatures in the area gain 5 temporary hit points.
datos.reinicio: The spectral warrior returns to the wall and ceases 2 rounds after all living creatures are out of sight of the stairs. After 6 hours the haunt is ready to trigger again.

spitting-acid-bushes-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall
spitting-acid-bushes-5-6.descripcion:
Four techno-organic "bush" structures featuring mini-acid pumps activate. The first lashes out with sharp "branches" as it activates, and then all of the bushes spit acid at movement nearby.

HP is 10 per bush with a BT of 5

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 or Engineering-lore DC 20 (trained) on each bush to collapse its acid pump into component parts (2 actions per bush).
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each bush disabled. On each of the hazard's actions, one of the functional pumps spits acid at a creature within range. The bushes sense movement, only targeting creatures that moved from their space on their most recent turn. This trap does not attack any single creature more than once per round. It does not take a multiple attack penalty.

sticky-web-lurker-noose.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-18: The Fanciful March of Urwal
sticky-web-lurker-noose.descripcion: Discreet webbing at throat level snags a creature that walks into it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) or Thievery DC 20 (expert) to rearrange the webbing.

stink-sap-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
stink-sap-trap.descripcion: A nozzle attached to a pressure sensor under the flagstone path sprays thick wads of smelly sap.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 15 (trained) to clog the nozzle or Athletics DC 14 (trained) to redirect the stream away from the path; the Athletics check can be made at a distance with a thrown object, but a critical failure triggers the trap's Sudden Spray.
datos.reinicio: 1 minute. The trap resets automatically twice before the supply of stink sap is exhausted.

strong-fire-sentry.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-06: Struck by Shadows
strong-fire-sentry.descripcion: A 5-foot burst pillar of magical fire travels along a track throughout the room. The pillar emits bright light out to 20 feet.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 23 (trained) or Thievery DC 23 (trained) once on the control panel deactivates the whole trap, or Thievery DC 20 (trained) twice on the track prevents the pillar from moving. Each check requires two actions.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The pillar Strides, following the track in the room. If the trap's track is broken, the pillar can still Stride, but its Speed is only 15 feet. The pillar cannot move at all if the track is destroyed. When the pillar moves, it deals 1d10+6 fire damage to any creatures whose space it moves through.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates once it no longer detects the presence of creatures in the room.

sudden-drop.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-03: Godsrain in a Godless Land
sudden-drop.descripcion: A portion of Manaket's sewer system is under construction and has been left covered by only a few planks of wood since the Godsrain. After two weeks of wear, they're ready to collapse.

datos.desactivar: If all the PCs succeed on a Perception check against the Stealth DC to spot the hazard, they're able to detour around the weakened boards without triggering it. There's not enough time for PCs who succeed on this check to warn PCs who fail.

summoning-rune-cockatrice.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors floats in the square above an invisible floor rune.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 18 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disrupt the rune's summoning effect; alternatively, Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 17) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 24 hours.

talhindir-s-despair.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
talhindir-s-despair.descripcion: Gentle crying rises to become overwhelming wails. The fungal carvings begin to weep blood that pools around the pillars

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 20 (trained) to overpower the frightening cries with a greater sound or Occultism DC 18 or Religion DC 18 (trained) to ritually disrupt the haunting.
datos.reinicio: If the haunt is not dispersed, it resets after 1 day.

thorns-of-the-rose-pit.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-12: The Burning of Greensteeples
thorns-of-the-rose-pit.descripcion: Decorated smooth-hewn flagstone flooring gives way along hidden seams to a 20-foot square, 25-foot-deep pit festooned with spikes and blades of petrified wood in the darkness below.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disable the trap door mechanism
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trap door must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

titanic-flytrap.descripcion: On the surface, a titanic flytrap appears to be a patch of the more common flytrap plant, but beneath murky waters it hides a far larger set of jaws, reaching 10 feet across and reinforced with woody branches and lined with paralytic hairs.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 21 (trained) to mislead the flytrap's sense of weight and pressure
datos.reinicio: 1 hour (or longer, after a large meal)

trapmaster-tok-s-surprise-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales
trapmaster-tok-s-surprise-3-4.descripcion: Pressure sensitive panels in the floor connect to a barrel of debris hidden in the hallway's ceiling

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) on the floor panels before the barrel falls

treacherous-quagmire.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-08: Revolution on the Riverside
treacherous-quagmire.descripcion: A patch of treacherous bog attempts to submerge creatures that step onto it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 18 (trained) to disturb the surface and make the quagmire plainly visible.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the quagmire pulls each creature within it 1 square toward the center of the quagmire and 1 step further submerged; a creature that is submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that is submerged up to its neck is pulled under and has to hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature in the quagmire can attempt a Athletics DC 20 check to Swim to either raise itself by 1 step if its submerged to its neck or worse, or to swim out of the quagmire if its submerged up to only its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down 1 step. A creature that Swims out of the quagmire escapes the hazard and is Prone adjacent to the quagmire. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar tool, or attempt to pull a creature within their reach out with a Athletics DC 20 check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check.
datos.reinicio: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 24 hours

treacherous-scree.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-16: The Heart of the City
treacherous-scree.descripcion: The footing on this sloped ground appears to be stable at first glance, but the tiny rocks that cover it are loosely packed and prone to slipping.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) to navigate a safe path

treasure-avalanche-3-4.descripcion: A large pile of treasure trembles precariously, threatening to collapse down into a crashing wave of coins and fine objects.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to remove the right pieces from the treasure pile and induce a controlled collapse.

unlucky-collapsing-tunnel.descripcion: At the unluckiest time, the shoddily supported tunnel wall collapses in on itself and floods the tunnel with dirt and stone.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 18 check to counteract the aura of unluck that pervades the tunnels for 1 minute, or Survival DC 20 to support the tunnel ceiling properly without triggering a collapse

unruly-crowd.descripcion: Concerned citizens shout slogans about the dangers of dealing with Cheliax and throw bricks at Chelaxian sympathizers.

datos.desactivar: Succeed at two of the following checks in any combination: Athletics DC 20 (trained) to confiscate dangerous debris, Diplomacy DC 20 (trained) to calm the crowd, Intimidation DC 18 (untrained) to scare the crowd away, Will DC 22 (trained) to maintain a brave and confident demeanor; an effect such as Calm that can target an area counts as one automatic success.
datos.rutina: (three actions) The unruly crowd uses an action to chant a Catchy Slogan if it is not already benefiting from the effect It uses Shake Confidence once per turn and uses its remaining actions for cobblestone Strikes.

unruly-mushrooms.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-12: Mischief in the Maze
unruly-mushrooms.descripcion: Giant mushrooms sprout from the ground, their caps reaching up to 15 feet high. Each giant mushroom flls up one 5-foot square and can appear anywhere within 20 feet of the center of the ring except adjacent to another giant mushroom. The ring can be disabled but not damaged before it activates.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 16 (trained) or Occultism DC 16 (trained) to repair the runes, Survival DC 20 (trained) to disturb the soil within the ring to weaken the mushrooms; one successful check to disable this hazard reduces the mushrooms' hardness to 0, and two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (two actions) A mushroom adjacent to one or more creatures uses Poison Spores. If there are no adjacent creatures, the mushroom vanishes in the ground and reappears in another square, making a Sprout attack. If no conscious creatures are within 20 feet of the center of the ring, the mushroom does nothing. A mushroom will not sprout underneath an Unconscious creature. Each mushroom only acts once.
datos.reinicio: The giant mushrooms start to wilt and disappear 1 minute after all conscious living creatures have left the area. After 1 hour, the magic recharges, and the hazard is ready to trigger again.

unstable-floor.descripcion: An unstable section of limestone crumbles under the weight of anyone who steps on it.

datos.desactivar: Engineering-lore DC 20, Mining-lore DC 20, or Survival DC 23 to determine the exact extent of the unstable ground and to optionally cause it to collapse safely into area A2 below

unstable-overlook.descripcion: A ledge overlooks a yawning chasm.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 20 to tread lightly across the overlook onto more stable ground. Permanently disabling the hazard requires several hours of work and a successful Crafting DC 23 check (trained).

violent-shove.descripcion: An invisible force bats creatures aside, hurling them into a nearby wall.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 19 (trained) to disperse the force or Religion DC 20 (trained) to ward yourself from harm
datos.reinicio: 1 day

wall-blades-trap.descripcion: A series of rotating, serrated blades attached to long poles routinely slice out of grooves carved into the stone walls.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disengage the mechanisms that operate the blades in one wall
datos.rutina: (3 actions) For each wall in which the mechanisms have been disabled or destroyed, the hazard has 1 fewer action. On each action, the hazard makes a serrated blade Strike against one creature within 10 feet of the west, east, or south wall. Each set of wall blades acts once per turn.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates when the room is empty and resets after 1 minute.

weeping-carved-mourner.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
weeping-carved-mourner.descripcion: The carving weeps. Its tears turn to a mist that covers the halls.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) to recite prayers for the dead, or Dwarven-lore DC 17 to speak the history of Raseri Kanton, or Thievery DC 23 to plug the holes in the carving
datos.reinicio: The trap resets whenever a creature enters the Labyrinth for the first time.

wind-buffets-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need
wind-buffets-3-4.descripcion: The wind grows fierce as a small planar fissure opens, blowing around leaves and creatures alike.

datos.desactivar: Arcana,nature,thievery DC 18 (trained) three times to counter the planar energies.
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) On its turn each round, the wind begins blowing fiercely from a random direction. All creatures must attempt a Reflex DC 18 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is moved 5 feet in the direction the wind is blowing.
Failure The creature is moved 10 feet in the direction the wind is blowing and is knocked Prone.
Critical Failure The creature is moved 10 feet in the direction the wind is blowing, is knocked prone, and is Stunned 1.

wooden-bullets-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
wooden-bullets-trap.descripcion: A hopper full of wooden sling bullets is attached to several launching devices, which spew the bullets at high velocity through various holes in the boards covering the window. A distinctive "click" and whirring sound indicate the trap has been sprung.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 17 (trained) to reinforce the porch pressure sensor or Crafting DC 15 (trained) to cover the holes launching the bullets
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The wooden bullets trap Strikes the two nearest creatures. It ignores Prone creatures as the bullets fly overhead.
datos.reinicio: The trap stops after 10 rounds or when the weight on the porch is removed, whichever comes first. The trap can operate for a total of 10 rounds before its ammunition is exhausted.

a-broken-promise-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-02: Return to the Grave
a-broken-promise-3-4.descripcion: The grove, broken and tormented due to the necromantic energy infecting the area it protected, manifests an illusion to warn others of the region's plight and plead for help. Pharasmin cleric and Pathfinder Seldrick Dralston trudges into the grove, injured and infected with some kind of evil corruption. He defiles the statue of Erastil in the center of the grove, and the golden light illuminating the grove ceases, revealing the black skies above. Purple magical energy emanating from a nearby tower seeps into the sacred grove, and the life within the grove's protection begins to die.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 22 (trained) or Religion DC 22 (trained) to convince the spirit of the wood the message has been understood
datos.reinicio: The haunt returns every 10 minutes to retell its tale. The haunting of the sacred grove is permanently put to rest if the shrine is reconsecrated, which is impossible unless the evil forces in the nearby watchtower are defeated.

abyss-warped-trees.descripcion: A forest of fiendish trees swing their branches and shift their roots to bludgeon and trip creatures in the tainted grove (area A21).

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 22 (trained) to find a location the trees can't reach or Religion DC 24 to recite a prayer that temporarily casts out the fiendish energy inside a single tree in the grove, disabling it for 1 minute. A disabled or destroyed tree creates a 5‑foot‑square area in the grove that's safe from this hazard.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The Abyss‑warped trees use their first action each round to lash their roots; each creature in the tainted grove must succeed at a Reflex DC 21 save or fall Prone. The Abyss‑warped trees use their second, third, and fourth actions to make branch Strikes against up to three different creatures in the tainted grove.
datos.reinicio: The Abyss-warped trees cease moving 1 minute after no living creatures are in the tainted grove. They reset immediately. A disabled tree reanimates after 1 minute. A destroyed tree regrows after 1 month.

accursed-cargo-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
accursed-cargo-3-4.descripcion: A wooden crate bearing a chthonic sigil glows with a power contained within it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to open the crate with gradual release of its magical energy, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to dispel the rune

acid-strongbox-trap.descripcion: An invisible magic field around the strongbox releases a spray of acid when disturbed.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (expert) to harmlessly bleed away the magical field or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 20) to dispel it.

ardax-s-puzzle-box.descripcion: A chest-sized puzzle box is covered in intricate designs, with no immediately obvious way to open it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 19 (trained), Thievery DC 18, and Perception DC 18 simultaneously by at least 3 characters; one of these checks can be replaced by a Strike against AC 19, and one can be replaced by targeting the box with a spell that has the electricity trait and deals at least 1 damage (this ignores the box's Hardness).
datos.reinicio: The box resets immediately.

automatic-fire-suppression-5-6.descripcion: Ceiling sprinklers spray in response to any fire in the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to jam the sprinkler system or Engineering Lore (trained) on the control panel on the north wall to turn the system off.

avalanche-doors.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
avalanche-doors.descripcion: The double door is a false door; when triggered, the door slams downward like a drawbridge to crush anyone standing before it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to detach the trigger from the doors and lock them in place

avernal-flashback.descripcion: A phantasmal crimson worm appears to rampage outside the workshop, afflicting the area with phantom tremors, blistering heat, and cave-ins.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 22, Occultism DC 22, or Religion DC 22; it takes three successful checks to weaken the haunt or erect supports that brace the ceiling. A PC who speaks Dwarven can attempt Diplomacy DC 22 (trained) checks to calm the phantasmal cave worm.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) Zogototaru uses 1 action to create a Tremor. With her other action, she either Exudes Heat or makes Rocks Fall, alternating between the two each round.

azlanti-elemental-nexus-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-02: The Blackwood Lost
azlanti-elemental-nexus-5-6.descripcion: A large cylindrical metallic structure surrounded by dense cables and pipes, anointed with mystical runes which glow and hum vibrantly. Elemental energy arcs off three spikes that may have once been connected to some of the cables.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 22 (trained) to restart the machine's connection to an elemental plane, or Thievery DC 25 (trained) to find and deactivate the whichever rune is currently active; three total successes are required to disable the nexus. A spike can be disabled with a Athletics DC 25 (trained) check to rip it from the structure or a Crafting DC 22 (trained) check to reconnect some of the cables. If all 6 elemental energies are returned to the nexus, it is disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The nexus spends each of its actions making an elemental wave Strike; each of these must be against a different creature who does not have the elemental trait. For each spike destroyed or disabled, the trap loses 1 action.

bittersweet-surprise.descripcion: A magic circle made of royal icing seals the trap door to the gristmill's basement shut and plays a nasty trick on anyone who tries to open it without all three of its gumdrop keys.

datos.desactivar: If the three magical gumdrops which act as this hazard's keys are placed at the correct points of the magic circle, its enchantment is disabled. Deciphering the correct locations requires a successful Arcana DC 20 or Occultism DC 20 check; on a critical failure, the mere act of placing the gumdrops activates the Malicious Metamorphosis reaction. Once the enchantment is disabled, the magic circles can be wiped away like any regular icing.
datos.reinicio: If the trap door is closed without the magic circles being disturbed, the enchantment resumes as normal.

blinding-spray.descripcion: A bladder of powdered peppers is secreted in a compartment above the door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to disable the blade that bursts the bladder

bloodthirsty-apparitions-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-04: An Enkindled Carnival
bloodthirsty-apparitions-5-6.descripcion: Deceased Puddles residents lash out at living creatures.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 18 (trained) three times to banish the apparitions with prayers, or Occultism DC 22 (trained) once to commune with the spirits and convince them to pass on
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt's screams send biting supernatural rain around the area, dealing 4d6 piercing damage to all living creatures within 90 feet (basic Reflex DC 21 save). Creatures who fail the save are Blinded by a red haze for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).
datos.reinicio: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't reform 1 minute after the Puddles phantom is slain.

breakaway-ladder.descripcion: The rope ladder rips free from its anchors and drops into the pit.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) or Crafting DC 22 (trained) to secure the ladder's anchors so they won't break

canopy-drop.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
canopy-drop.descripcion: A trapdoor, connected to floor sensors, opens in the section of floor marked on the map, while the surrounding floor suddenly tilts to a 45-degree angle and the fountains in the wall begin spraying at high pressure, making the tile slippery and pushing creatures toward the open chute.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to jam the mechanisms and keep the trapdoor from opening, or to locate the bypass switch hidden under a stair riser just outside the room

catacomb-cave-in.fuente: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On
catacomb-cave-in.descripcion: The ceiling is unstable, and any Medium or larger creature that approaches within 5 feet of the collapsed tunnel triggers a cave-in.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (trained) to prop up the ceiling in key locations prior to the cave-in.

cave-in.descripcion: The tunnel collapses, filling the passage with stone.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 25 (trained) to prop up the tunnel ceiling without triggering a collapse

collapsing-ceiling.descripcion: A 5-foot-square section in the ceiling is in danger of collapsing. A character can use a Crafting check instead of a Perception check to detect the hazard.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 21 (trained) to support the damaged area against a collapse

collapsing-cell.descripcion: A section of ceiling and iron cell bars collapse inward.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) or Crafting DC 25 (trained) to use a loose iron bar to shore up the ceiling.

color-spray-trap.descripcion: A loud pop sounds when this door is opened, followed immediately by a blast of colorful lights that washes over whoever opened the door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) to disable the glyph, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the glyph

crowd-with-chamberpots.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
crowd-with-chamberpots.descripcion: The crowd is riled up enough to start throwing chamberpots at the interlopers, but not riled up enough to risk their lives. The crowd fills nine contiguous squares but can be shaped to fit the streets. Characters can move through the crowd, but spaces occupied by the crowd are difficult terrain.

datos.desactivar: After more people in the crowd have become shaken or taken damage than there are crowd leaders left standing, the crowd disperses. For abilities affecting an area, count each affected square as one member of the crowd.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The crowd uses its first action to Stride away from any opponent adjacent to them (or to get within 30 feet), then uses each remaining action to make a chamber pot Strike at a different target.
datos.reinicio: After more people in the crowd have become shaken or taken damage than there are crowd leaders left standing, the crowd disperses. For abilities affecting an area, count each affected square as one member of the crowd.

crushing-crowd-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-01: Intro to the Year of Immortal Influence
crushing-crowd-3-4.descripcion: The crowd rushes forward, risking a stampede as everyone tries to fnd a safe exit.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 18 to calm the crowd, or Intimidation DC 21 or Society DC 21 to control the crowd's behavior
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the crowd moves 5 feet toward the exit in area A1, then crushes any creature in a 10-foot emanation, dealing 4d6 bludgeoning damage. All targets must attempt a basic Reflex DC 21 save.
Failure The target takes full damage and becomes Prone.
Critical Failure The target takes double damage, becomes prone, and is Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

crushing-spirits-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-09: The Secluded Siege
crushing-spirits-5-6.descripcion: Spirits bound to sand-covered remains cascade down upon the living, imposing the weighty, helpless press of their final moments.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 18 or Occultism DC 18 (trained) to exorcise the spirits, or Diplomacy DC 22 to provide them with comfort. Each check requires 2 actions, which have the verbal trait, and three successful checks are required to address all ofthe spirits.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The haunt imposes the sensation of becoming buried beneath millions of grains of sand on all living creatures within the area. Each living creature must attempt a Will DC 21 save as the sensation threatens to overcome them. The creatures take 1d10+6 bludgeoning damage.

—

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all its Speeds for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all its Speeds for 1 round. It also begins suffocating. The creature can begin breathing normally again if it leaves the area of the haunt or the haunt is disabled.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes double damage.

Effect: Crushing Spirits
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

death-of-the-dollmaker.descripcion: The death of Thalleus Jongrim—in his bed, surrounding by ritualistic implements—repeats in ghostly form.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 21 (trained) to snuff out one of four ghostly candles or Religion DC 23 (trained) three times to calm what is left of Thalleus's fractured spirit
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt recreates the moment when Thalleus dies, causing the ritual to go awry. This releases a wave of void energy, dealing 4d8 void damage in a 10-foot emanation from the bed (basic Fortitude DC 21 save). This damage is reduced by 1d8 for every ghostly candle that has been snuffed out.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures have left the room. One hour after this or being Disabled, the haunt is ready to trigger again. Putting Thalleus's spirit to rest permanently destroys the haunt.

enhanced-brown-mold.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
enhanced-brown-mold.descripcion: This unassuming fungus leeches heat out of the air.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 22 (trained) to safely remove the mold
datos.reinicio: After expanding, the brown mold can't grow again for 1 day.

falling-tree.descripcion: A partially sawn tree collapses onto the path.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 21 (trained) to predict and avoid the tree's collapse location or Thievery DC 21 (trained) to prop it up.

final-words.descripcion: As a creature touches a hand-written letter, they witness the letter's author scribe it in the past; each pen stroke across the page carves the letter's text into the creature's flesh.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 24 (trained) to ward off the haunt or Thievery DC 25 (trained) to dispose of the letter with extreme care before the haunt can form
datos.reinicio: 1 minute

flooding-monolith-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-14: Lost in Flames
flooding-monolith-5-6.descripcion: A surge of abyssal energy creates a powerful wave pushing away from the monolith.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 22, Occultism DC 22, or Religion DC 22 to magically alter the runes, or Thievery DC 25 to physically alter them. A PC that can read Abyssal or Cyclops is better able to identify key runes, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to these check (+2 if they speak both). Each check requires two actions, and disabling the monolith requires three successful checks. A PC that critically succeeds earns two success. On a failed check, the attempting PC is exposed to the burning flames wreathing the monolith, taking 2d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save).
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On the hazard's turn it sends a wave of water along the fork of the river (North, South, or East) that contains the nearest PC. Any creature along that fork in or on the surface of the water must attempt a Fortitude DC 22 save.

The monolith's guardians are accustomed to these surges and are immune to this effect.

—

Critical Success The creature takes advantage of the undertow after the surge to reposition themselves. The creature can Step, ignoring difficult terrain caused by the water.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is pushed 10 feet away from the monolith.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 15 feet away from the monolith and knocked Prone.

floor-chute-trap.descripcion: A pivoted section of a seemingly normal hallway becomes a chute that deposits victims into a more dangerous room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to prevent the floor from pivoting
datos.reinicio: Provided no creature is on the slide, the trap resets after 1 minute, returning the hallway floor to its normal, unassuming state.

forest-fire.descripcion: A 10‑foot‑by‑10‑foot bonfire spreads to the surrounding forest on each of its turns.

datos.desactivar: A successful Athletics DC 22, Nature DC 22, or Survival DC 22 check from an adjacent square is sufficient to smother one 5‑foot‑square of fire; each attempt is an Interact action. Dousing the flames automatically extinguishes one or more sections of fire, with no check. Water typically clears a 5‑foot square if the amount is small (such as from a spell like create water or hydraulic push). Larger amounts of water, such as a full bucket, typically douse a 10‑foot‑by‑10‑foot area (or 4 squares in some other shape). Throwing a bucket of water on flames requires an Interact action. A waterskin doesn't contain enough water to put out even 1 square of fire. Cold can also put out fire, but only if the cold can affect an area; cold is less effective than water, so a frost vial puts out only 1 square of fire, and a ray of frost is ineffective.
datos.rutina: On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies (minimum 1 square). You determine the squares the fire spreads into. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes 2d8+5 fire damage, or 4d8+10 fire damage if it ended its turn within the flames (basic Reflex DC 25 in either case). A creature can take damage from the forest fire only once per round.

formian-sting-trench.descripcion: A thin layer of canvas conceals this 10-foot-square pit, the walls of which are studded with dagger-sized formian stingers. Creatures that fall into the trap risk being gouged by the poisonous barbs.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained)
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the canvas must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

gala-crowd.descripcion: The panicked crowd of gala attendees reacts to the unexpected attack.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 19, Diplomacy DC 21, or Athletics DC 24 to get guests to move out of harm's way; four total successes across all skills are required to disable the hazard
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The crowd reacts in one of the following ways, determined by a d12 die roll:
• 1–2 Hunker Down: The crowd freezes in fear. It provides lesser cover to all creatures in the great room for 1 round.
• 3–4 Run!: Determine a random direction. Each creature in the area must succeed at a Fortitude DC 21 save or be moved 10 feet in that direction. On a critical failure, they're also knocked Prone. This is forced movement.
• 5–6 Hysteria: The crowd's dread is contagious. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will DC 21 save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure). This is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.
• 7–8 Wailing: The cries make it hard to concentrate. For 1 round, any creature in the area that attempts an action with the concentrate trait must succeed at a Flat DC 4 or the action is disrupted. This is an auditory effect.
