• 9–10 Crushing Press: Members of the crowd shove and push, trying to find a way to safety. Each creature in the area takes 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 21 save).
• 11–12 Wild Dismay: The chaos is overwhelming. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will DC 21 save or become Confused for 1 round. This is an emotion and mental effect.

grasping-gems.descripcion: Four magically treated gems used to store fragments of souls begin glowing with an eerie malevolence.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 22 (trained), Occultism DC 22 (trained), or Nature DC 22 (trained) to quiet one of the four grasping gems
datos.rutina: (2 actions) During the haunt's first action, the grasping gems attempt an Athletics check (at a +14 modifier) to Grapple each non-Immobilized living creature in the room, rolling once and comparing the result to each target's Fortitude DC. For every gem that is disabled or destroyed, the haunt takes a cumulative –1 circumstance penalty to the check. For the haunt's second action, the gems' ghostly hands squeeze their victims. Each creature immobilized by the haunt takes 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 21 save).
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures have left the room. One hour after this or being Disabled, the haunt is ready to trigger again. Putting Thalleus's spirit to rest permanently destroys the haunt.

greater-blood-shadow-mirror.descripcion: A dark shape moves in the surface of an ornate mirror, its eyes wide as blood seeps down its tormented face.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to fully cover the mirror or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 22) to dispel the mirror.
datos.rutina:
(2 actions; arcane, mental) The bloody figure in the mirror transforms to reflect a creature within 30 feet. The reflection bleeds profusely from the eyes, nose, and mouth, and the reflected creature must attempt a Will DC 21 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.
Success The creature bleeds from their mouth or nose.
Failure The creature bleeds from their eyes, mouth, and nose, and takes 2d8 persistent damage.
Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is Frightened 1.
datos.reinicio: 1 minute if no fresh blood has been spilled.

handheld-quaker-mk-2.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
handheld-quaker-mk-2.descripcion: This small toy-like device has a hidden mechanism meant to be activated by the user, but the centuries have eroded its magical-mechanical components to the point that they activate at the slightest touch.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to deactivate the mechanism; Crafting DC 20 (trained) to identify and repair the problem components; two successes are required to disable the hazard
datos.rutina:
At its initiative, to determine what the quaker does, roll  and consult the following table:
1: No action
2: A small quake: the terrain in a 10-foot emanation centered on the quaker shakes briefly. A creature in an affected square is knocked Prone (Reflex DC 21 save).
3: A medium quake: the terrain within the vault shakes constantly, transforming it into difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is knocked prone and takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage from the fall (basic Reflex DC 21 save).
4: A great quake: the terrain within the vault moves in waves, transforming it into greater difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is violently slammed to the ground, knocked prone and taking 2d8+6 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 25 save).
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without a creature being within 5' of the handheld quaker.

hidden-forest-bog-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-99: Blessings of the Forest
hidden-forest-bog-3-4.descripcion: A 15-foot wide area of verdant-covered water attempts to suck creatures down into it.

datos.desactivar: Two Survival DC 22 (trained) checks to find roots and tree limbs sturdy enough for everyone to use as escape paths ends the hazard's threat to all creatures in the area
datos.rutina:
(one action) On its initiative, the bog pulls down each creature within it. A creature that was submerged to its waist becomes submerged to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature partially or fully submerged in the bog can attempt a Athletics DC 20 check to Swim to either raise itself by one step (pulled under to submerged to its neck, or submerged to its neck to submerged to its waist), or to escape from the bog if it's submerged only up to its waist. This DC increases to Athletics DC 22 for creatures submerged up to their neck or worse. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step. Other creatures can Aid, typically by using a rope or similar assistance (providing an automatic success), or attempt to pull a single affected creature out with their own Athletics check, with the same results as if the aiding creature attempted the check itself.
datos.reinicio: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it accumulates leaf and greenery cover over the course of 24 hours.

history-s-repetition-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
history-s-repetition-3-4.descripcion: Pebbles form into a hand the size of an ox, which reaches to crush anyone in the water.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to pick apart the pebbles, or Warfare-lore DC 18 to recognize and recreate the battle
datos.reinicio: 24 hours

hostile-architecture-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
hostile-architecture-3-4.descripcion: The sigils on the door's frame glow with an amber light, which collects in a facet over the center of the door.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 17 (trained) to strategically destroy the runes, Thievery DC 18 to disrupt the beam from collecting the facet, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank, counteract DC 18) to dispel the rune
datos.rutina: a The hostile architecture fires its aversion beam on a creature that is sanctified holy. If there are no sanctified holy creatures, it instead fires its beam on the nearest non-demon creature.
datos.reinicio: The Hostile Architecture resets after being exposed to the light of a blue moon.

ice-fall-trap.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: The Fall of Plaguestone
ice-fall-trap.descripcion: Compartments in the ceiling are rigged to drop a freezing alchemical liquid into the entire room if the door is opened without using the key.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) on the door allows it to be opened without springing the trap.

iron-dart-launcher.descripcion: A half‑dozen iron darts fire from spring‑loaded launchers concealed in the desk opposite the front door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to disable the trigger, or Acrobatics DC 18 to squeeze through the partially opened door (this doesn't disable the trap but prevents it from triggering)
datos.reinicio: The trap resets as soon as the door is closed. It has enough darts to trigger three times, after which, it must be reloaded with 20 darts before it can reset again.

major-unstable-furniture-archway.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
major-unstable-furniture-archway.descripcion: This unsteady pile of furniture is piled to the top of this usually high-ceilinged room. There looks to be some space to squeeze through to the other side, but even the slightest touch causes the stack to destabilize, and there's so much that once it begins to fall, it's difficult to stop.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 25 to knock the pile over in a safe direction or Thievery DC 23 (trained) to carefully rearrange the furniture to a more stable configuration.
datos.rutina: On its initiative, the pile expands into an adjacent space, dealing creatures in that space 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex DC 21 save, pushing them into an adjacent empty space, and making that space impassable until cleared. If no adjacent empty space is available, the pile buries the creature, suffocating it. Clearing a space or pulling a creature out requires a Athletics DC 18 check.

manipulator-s-metronome-3-4.descripcion: The hypnotic ticking of this metronome captures the attention of all who approach it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 or Crafting DC 18 to interfere with the metronome's mechanisms, Athletics DC 22 to grip the hand and prevent it from moving, or Arcana DC 22 or Occultism DC 22 to interpret the magic runes on the metronome and counteract its effects. Three successful checks are required to fully disable the metronome, ending its ticking.

moldy-foodstuffs-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave
moldy-foodstuffs-3-4.descripcion: A mold cloud puffs from spoiled spilled food.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 16 (trained) to remove the mold from the food without triggering the spores.

muesello-s-elite-summoning-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-11: No Time for Treason
muesello-s-elite-summoning-rune.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 20 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 22 (trained) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 19) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

murderous-bathhouse-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-13: Devil at the Crossroads
murderous-bathhouse-3-4.descripcion: Linneus's grudge manifests as a haunt that isolates creatures in the bathroom and attempts to psychically drown them in one of three containers of water: the sink, the bath, or the wash bucket.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 22 (expert) to exorcise the spirit from one of the containers of water, or Athletics DC 23 or Thievery DC 23 (trained) to overpower the ghostly force sealing a container and drain it. All three containers must be disabled to disable the entire haunt.
datos.rutina:
(one action) One creature within the room must attempt a Will DC 23 save as the haunt attempts to drown them.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure A ghostly version of the creature's face appears in the water of the sink, the bath, or the wash bucket. The creature immediately experiences the sensation of being underwater, and if it can't breathe water, it must begin to hold its breath to avoid suffocation. The haunt can affect only one creature per container remaining in the haunt. If the creature leaves the room, it's immediately freed.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature immediately loses 1d4 actions' worth of air.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

mushroom-ring-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-00: The King in Thorns
mushroom-ring-3-4.descripcion: This mushroom ring forms a portal to the First World, allowing the Thorned Monarch's reinforcements into the Material Plane. When the PCs approach, a creature emerges. Creatures continue to emerge until the mushroom ring is disabled. Disabling the mushroom ring also causes any creatures that have emerged to disappear.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) or Nature DC 22 to rearrange the mushrooms to disrupt the portal (two actions) or Dispel Magic (2nd rank, counteract DC 20) to counteract the magical properties; three successes are required to disable the portal
datos.rutina: (1 action) A Nuglub emerges from the mushroom ring and defends it. All nuglubs use the mushroom ring's initiative.

oil-explosion.descripcion: The flammable oil catches flame and explodes, burning up in a ball of fire.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 25 (trained) or Crafting DC 23 to neutralize the oil without setting it alight

paper-locust-swarm.descripcion: A book unfurls and its case forms into a leathery locust, its pages folding into an overwhelming swarm.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 to tear up the leather locust, or Arcana DC 18 (trained) or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 22) to render the magic inert.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The swarm moves up to 30 feet to share the nearest creature's space, slicing into them with their paper wings and spurs. The targeted creature must attempt a Reflex DC 21 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes 2d8+5 slashing damage.
Failure The creature takes 2d8 slashing damage and 1d6 persistent damage.
Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is Clumsy 1.
datos.reinicio: The paper locust swarm resets after 1 minute if there are no creatures to target.

pile-of-fireworks-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #5: The Dragon who Stole Evoking Day
pile-of-fireworks-5-6.descripcion: A pile of stolen and volatile fireworks.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 21 (trained), Engineering-lore DC 19 (trained), or Explosives-lore DC 19 (trained) to safely remove the lit firework or Thievery DC 21 (trained) to remove the lit fuse from the firework.

pit-of-lives-lost-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #15: In the Footsteps of Horror
pit-of-lives-lost-3-4.descripcion: The spout trickling blood, sludge, and offal begins to draw upon your life energy, increasing the flow and spreading an even fouler smell within the chamber.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 20 or Religion DC 20 (trained) to counteract the fell energies drawing in life force to power this strange charnel flow or Thievery DC 23 (trained) to disable the spout, stopping the flow at its source.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

port-peril-bar-fight-last-catch-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #4: Port Peril Pub Crawl
port-peril-bar-fight-last-catch-3-4.descripcion: An assorted crowd throws punches, flings bottles, and otherwise flies into chaos as a bar fight breaks out, clustering in six sections of one of Port Peril's drinking houses.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 22 to cow a section of crowd or Diplomacy DC 25 to attempt to disperse it
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The bar fight uses its first action to make a general mayhem Strike against all creatures in any area that has not been disabled. Make one Strike against each enemy in the area and roll the damage only once for all targets. The bar fight then uses its second action to use Port Peril specialty.

port-peril-bar-fight-rivanti-s-bar-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #4: Port Peril Pub Crawl
port-peril-bar-fight-rivanti-s-bar-3-4.descripcion: An assorted crowd throws punches, flings bottles, and otherwise flies into chaos as a bar fight breaks out, clustering in six sections of one of Port Peril's drinking houses.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 22 to cow a section of crowd or Diplomacy DC 25 to attempt to disperse it
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The bar fight uses its first action to make a general mayhem Strike against all creatures in any area that has not been disabled. Make one Strike against each enemy in the area and roll the damage only once for all targets. The bar fight then uses its second action to use Port Peril specialty.

port-peril-bar-fight-the-watchtower-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #4: Port Peril Pub Crawl
port-peril-bar-fight-the-watchtower-3-4.descripcion: An assorted crowd throws punches, flings bottles, and otherwise flies into chaos as a bar fight breaks out, clustering in six sections of one of Port Peril's drinking houses.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 22 to cow a section of crowd or Diplomacy DC 25 to attempt to disperse it
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The bar fight uses its first action to make a general mayhem Strike against all creatures in any area that has not been disabled. Make one Strike against each enemy in the area and roll the damage only once for all targets. The bar fight then uses its second action to use Port Peril specialty.

practice-guard-s-grasp.descripcion: A spring-loaded net fires from the dummy, then is pulled tightly back in with magnets.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to jam the net or Athletics DC 25 to knock the dummy over

punishing-altar.descripcion: The bowl releases a wave of negative energy when a living creature approaches without displaying a religious symbol of Venexus.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (expert) to remove the bowl without triggering the magic, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank, counteract DC 20) to counteract the runes

rain-soaked-crowd-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-04: An Enkindled Carnival
rain-soaked-crowd-5-6.descripcion: A crowd of carnival goers are spurred to panic by supernatural rain.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 21 (trained) to calm them down, Intimidation DC 22 (trained) to cow them, Athletics DC 24 (trained) to force them back

razor-snare.descripcion: Slender razor wire snags a creature, yanking its feet to knock it down.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 22 or Thievery DC 22 (trained) to snip the wire without getting snared

relive-the-rending-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-19: Enter the Pallid Peak
relive-the-rending-3-4.descripcion: The room shakes violently, as it did during the Rending, and the spirits of dozens of dwarves make a mad dash for safety, their terror palpable.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 18, Intimidation DC 18, or Religion DC 18 to calm the panicked spirits, or Athletics DC 20 to wrestle them into a semblance of order. Two successful checks are required to deactivate the haunt, and each attempt requires two actions.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Phantom dwarves trample toward the exit, dealing 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage to each living creature in the area (basic Reflex DC 23 save). On a critical failure, a creature is also knocked Prone.

A creature that attempts to Stand after being inside the haunt's area must succeed at a Flat DC 11 check or else get knocked back down by the trampling spirits.
datos.reinicio: Unless deactivated, the haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter. If deactivated, the haunt resets after 24 hours.

rending-hands.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
rending-hands.descripcion: Illusory hands tear from the floorboards, clawing at their victim's legs and leaving real wounds.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 20 (trained) to exorcize the spirits
datos.reinicio: The underlying spirits remain, resetting the haunt every midnight, until the true story of what happened here becomes public.

rickety-bridge.descripcion: The bridge creaks and strains alarmingly.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 25 to Repair the bridge as an individual hexploration activity.

rolling-death.descripcion: A trip wire hidden in the dust of the midway point of the floor releases a large boulder to roll from the northwestern corridor toward A4, crushing anything it meets.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to set the trip wire to a different anchor point without changing the tension

rope-net-trap.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-09: Equal Exchange - Skymetal Hoard
rope-net-trap.descripcion: This trap is a net weaved from rope laid out beneath the jungle underbrush with mechanisms attached to some nearby trees; when triggered, it cases the target in the net and suspends them indefinitely.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 14 to cut the triggering length of rope

rowdy-crowd.descripcion: Concerned citizens shout slogans about the dangers of dealing with Cheliax and throw bricks at Chelaxian sympathizers.

datos.desactivar: Succeed at two of the following checks in any combination: Athletics DC 22 (trained) to confiscate dangerous debris, Diplomacy DC 22 (trained) to calm the crowd, Intimidation DC 20 (untrained) to scare the crowd away, Will DC 24 (trained) to maintain a brave and confident demeanor; an effect such as Calm that can target an area counts as one automatic success.
datos.rutina: (three actions) The unruly crowd uses an action to chant a Catchy Slogan if it is not already benefiting from the effect It uses Shake Confidence once per turn and uses its remaining actions for cobblestone Strikes.

sadistic-conductor.descripcion: A phantom conductor appears with a flourish, causing spectral instruments with razor-like strings to appear in the hands of those present. As the conductor gestures for the performance to begin, creatures are compelled to play the instruments.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 18 to perform so well the conductor releases you from your instrument, banishing it voluntarily; Occultism DC 22 (trained) or Religion DC 22 (trained) to banish one instrument; or Thievery DC 25 (trained) to sabotage one instrument; each instrument must be banished, sabotaged, or destroyed to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action; enchantment, mental, occult) The conductor urges each creature within 30 feet to play the hazardous instrument it holds. Each creature that is compelled to play its instrument does so, and those who succeeded on their save can choose to do so. Playing the instrument, either from the haunt's routine or of a creature's own volition during an attempt to disable the haunt, deals 1d6+3 slashing damage (basic Reflex DC 21 save), and the creature must attempt a Performance DC 18 check. On a success, the conductor accepts the performance and dismisses that creature's instrument, and on a critical failure, the discordant sound and conductor's jeers deal an additional 1d6+3 sonic damage.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates when all conjured instruments are destroyed or there has been silence for 1 minute. It resets after 1 hour.

scholar-s-bane.descripcion: Illusions overwhelm the minds of particularly intelligent creatures, forcing them to relive every intellectual failure and shame they've ever suffered.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to carve out one eye sensor, Arcana DC 22 or Occultism DC 22 (trained) to blank out one's mind (disables trap for self only), or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract one eye sensor
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap uses each action to target a creature in the room with an Intelligence score of 10 or greater. A target must succeed at a Will DC 22 save or take 2d8+2 mental damage. On a critical failure, the creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed for 1 minute as they stagger under the weight of their failures. The trap loses 1 action for each eye sensor disabled or destroyed.
datos.reinicio: The trap can function for 10 rounds, which don't need to be consecutive, before it must recharge for 24 hours.

scythe-blades-bb.fuente: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star
scythe-blades-bb.descripcion: Two blades, each hidden in a 15-foot-long ceiling groove, are both connected to a trip wire.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 to disable each blade.

season-s-toll-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-16: The Perennial Crown Part 1, Opal of Bhopan
season-s-toll-3-4.descripcion: Arcs of primal energy emerge from the L-shaped stone wall at the center of each alcove.

datos.desactivar:
1 Crafting DC 25 or Thievery DC 25 (expert) to rig up a dummy or other object to distract one of the trap's sensors, or

1 Nature DC 23 (trained) to temporarily befuddle one of the sensors with knowledge of primal magic.

Alternatively, inserting the correct key into an alcove's keyhole disables that alcove's sensor.
datos.rutina:
(4 actions) The trap loses one action per magical sensor disabled. On its initiative, the trap uses each of its actions to target one creature adjacent to or within an alcove with a negative effect that corresponds to the season opposite the one depicted on the alcove's murals (Fortitude DC 24 to resist). For the purposes of this trap, creatures who are within an alcove's landscape count are within that alcove. The trap can target only one creature per alcove per round.

—

Spring Alcove (death) The decay of late autumn takes hold of the target.

• Critical Success The trap has no effect.

• Success The target takes 2d6 void damage.

• Failure The target takes 4d6 void damage.

• Critical Failure The target takes 4d6 void damage and 1d6 persistent damage. Effects that use vitality energy, such as the Heal spell, automatically end this persistent damage.

—

Summer Alcove (cold) Winter's bitter chill descends on the target.

• Critical Success The trap has no effect.

• Success The target takes 2d6 cold damage.

• Failure The target takes 4d6 cold damage.

• Critical Failure The target takes 4d6 cold damage;and is Enfeebled 1 for 1 hour.

—

Autumn Alcove (poison) Poisonous springtime pollen sprays at the target.

• Critical Success The trap has no effect.

• Success The target takes 2d6 poison damage.

• Failure The target takes 4d6 poison damage.

• Critical Failure The target takes 4d6 poison damage and is Drained 1.

—

Winter Alcove (fire) Heat greater than the hottest summer afternoon engulfs the target.

• Critical Success The trap has no effect.

• Success The target takes 2d6 fire damage.

• Failure The target takes 4d6 fire damage.

• Critical Failure The target takes 4d6 fire damage and is Dazzled for 1 hour.
datos.reinicio: The trap is powered by the Eternal Bloom. It resets after 5 minutes, at which time the doors to the vault slam shut once again.

shadow-walls.fuente: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 20, Nature DC 20, Occultism DC 20, or Religion DC 20 on each of the shadow walls (disabling three of the four walls ends the hazard), or activating the orrery with the unlit star as noted in "The Orrery of Light."
datos.rutina:
Each turn, the walls use 1 action. Roll a {d10} and look up the result on the following list to determine which action the walls uses that round.
1–4 Single Target The walls lash out at a random hero in the room. Roll a {d4} and count to the number you rolled, starting with the player on your left, to determine which hero gets attacked. The shadow lash is a ranged Strike with +10 to hit. On a hit, it deals 2d6 void damage (doubled on a critical hit as normal).
5–7 Wall Barrage The shadow arms lunge out from their respective wall, assaulting any one near an active wall. This hits any creature within 10 feet of an active wall (within 10 feet of a shadow hand on the map), dealing 2d6 void damage. Each hero must attempt a basic Reflex DC 15 save, taking no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, full damage on a failure, and double damage on a critical failure.
8–9 Split Assault The shadows lash out against one half of the room. Roll {any die}. If the result is even, they assault the western half; otherwise, they assault the eastern half. This deals 2d6 void damage to each creature in that half of the room, and each hero must attempt a basic Reflex DC 15 save.
10 Overwhelming Assault Like the split assault attack, but it targets everyone in the room.

shroud-of-silence.descripcion: Sounds become muted in a 20-foot-wide, 100-foot-long segment of this street corridor.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 25 (expert) to twist the magic of the ley line around you, disabling the hazard for only you; or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 23) to disable the hazard permanently

spear-launcher-q9-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales
spear-launcher-q9-3-4.descripcion: A wall socket loaded with a spear connects to a floor tile in one 5-foot square.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) on the floor tile or wall socket

spiked-doorframe.descripcion: Spikes lance out of the doorframe to skewer anyone who attempts to open the door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to deactivate a trigger built into the door's handle

spiky-pit-trap.descripcion: A piece of hide covered with a layer of dirt and gravel is suspended over a 20-foot pit filled with spikes.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to manually trigger the trap without falling in, or Thievery DC 25 (trained) to secure the hide so the trap doesn't activate.
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the hide that covers it must be reset manually (a 10-minute activity) for the trap to become hidden again.

stair-spikes.descripcion: A set of Hidden spikes stabs into the feet of anyone on the landing or front stairs.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to unhook the pressure plate or Crafting DC 24 (trained) to block the spikes

storasta-s-last-stand-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-15: A Dirge for Sarkoris
storasta-s-last-stand-3-4.descripcion: A ghostly host of god callers and their eidolons manifests to defend the barrow against intruders, and the strains of a battle song fill the air.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 22 to appear to be a defender of Storasta, Diplomacy DC 22 to demonstrate benign intentions, or Occultism DC 20 or Religion DC 20 to ward off the malevolent spiritual energies. Two successful checks are required to disable the haunt, and each attempt requires two actions.
datos.rutina: (1 action) (holy, illusion, mental, occult) The haunt attacks what it believes is a demonic incursion, dealing 1d8+3 mental and 1d8 spirit damage to each living creature in the area (basic Will DC 21 save).
datos.reinicio: The haunt dissipates 1 minute after all living creatures leave area C1. Its spiritual energies re-form after 24 hours.

suncatcher-blooms-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-13: Within the Prairies
suncatcher-blooms-3-4.descripcion: Bright, iridescent blue petals sprout from the cerulean center of this flower.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 (trained) to safely move thorugh the flowers without activating the pollen.

toppling-shelves.descripcion: This stone bookshelf is badly compromised. It's just one push away from toppling over.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (expert) or Engineering Lore (trained) to shore up the shelf

tylegmut-s-last-meal.descripcion: The former bank manager's ghostly presence tempts creatures to partake in a dubious meal.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 18 (trained) to say a prayer to Urgathoa and put the haunt temporarily to rest until it resets, Occultism DC 22 (trained) to commune with the bank manager's spirit and convince her to permanently pass on, disabling the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt sends a cloud of dust and bone shards hurtling about the room. The dust and bones batter all creatures in the room, dealing 4d6 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 21). Creatures who fail the save are Blinded for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).
datos.reinicio: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature eats a full meal at the desk-this can be any food, not just the "food" at hand.

unstable-column-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
unstable-column-5-6.descripcion: Plaster crumbles from this column moments before it collapses.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 22 (trained) to stabilize the column, Athletics DC 25 to push the column back into place

valmar-s-pit-trap.descripcion: The ground here is made of loosely packed soil that, when stepped upon, collapses.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 22 (trained) to reinforce the dirt so it's safe to walk on, or Thievery DC 18 (trained) to collapse the trap from a safe distance
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the pit, but the soil must be replaced for the trap to become hidden again.

vengeful-furnace.descripcion: The hatch atop the haunted furnace flips open and disgorges a pair of shrieking, burning ghosts.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 22 (trained) to cow one of the vengeful spirits or Religion DC 25 (trained) to exorcise the spirit. The haunt remains active until both spirits are cowed or exorcised, or until the furnace is destroyed.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The burning ghosts lash at a random Stupefied creature in the room (or any random creature, if no creatures in the room are stupefied).
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets 1 hour after there are no creatures in the room.

vision-of-netherspace.descripcion: An ornate wooden throne decorated with the Eye of Aroden offers a harrowing and very realistic vision to those who sit upon it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 to deface hidden runes that trigger the trap or Arcana DC 24 or Religion DC 24 to blunt the trap's magical effects. Once disabled in any of these ways, the vision of netherspace still grants the complex vision, but the triggering creature ignores the effects of a failure or critical failure, treating both of those instead as successes.

watching-wall.descripcion: An overwhelming feeling of being watched wells up in the minds of those in the room, an instant before an eerie red eye opens in the western wall.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 22 (trained) to appear uninteresting to the watching eye (and thus be ignored by it) or Religion DC 22 (trained) to ward against being seen by or affected by the eye.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The eye glances about, and those it can see (whether in area C4 or outside of it) take 4d6 mental damage (basic Will DC 21 save) as fears of being watched impart ripples of pain.

A creature that takes mental damage from this effect doesn't reduce their Frightened value at the end of their next turn.
datos.reinicio: The haunt becomes inert at the end of any round in which there are no Frightened creatures it can see. It stays dormant for 1 hour, after which point it resets.

whispering-souls.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
whispering-souls.descripcion: Lost spirits whisper, reliving their last moments, ready to drag the living into their illusion.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 19 (trained) to suppress the spirits or Performance DC 19 (trained) to drown them out
datos.reinicio: The underlying spirits remain, resetting the haunt every midnight, until what truly happened here becomes public.

abendego-s-squall-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
abendego-s-squall-3-4.descripcion: A massive orca known as Abendego's Squall leaps from the water. Its mouth opens to snap against any part of the ship that it can reach.

datos.desactivar: Medicine DC 23 (trained) to remove the harpoon, Nature DC 21 (trained) to calm the orca, or Intimidation DC 23 (trained) to scare the orca away; two total successes are required to subdue the orca
datos.rutina:
d Abendego's Squall thrashes against the hull of the Snapdragon. With each action, it makes a flipper Strike against a PC adjacent to the railing. Whenever it makes a flipper Strike, it also deals its Strike damage to the ship whether or not the Strike was successful.

—
Speed 30 feet

adagio.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
adagio.descripcion: A flock of animated paper birds flit about to the playful sounds of an invisible flute, played by the invisible janni Mehryar.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 23 (trained) to create beautiful flying objects to complement the paper birds; Acrobatics DC 25 or Performance DC 22 (Performance DC 18 if using a flute) (trained) to perform along with the flute and paper birds (requires two successes); or one successful attack roll against the Invisible Mehryar (AC 23, Perception DC 23 to determine Mehryar's location)
datos.rutina: (3 actions) On each of the trap's actions, the flock of paper birds attacks a different creature. On a successful hit, each target must attempt a Reflex DC 23 save. On a failure, they take 1d6 persistent damage.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if no hostile creatures remain outside.

aeon-nexus-5-6.descripcion: A small cluster of aeon stones floats two feet off the ground, orbiting by shards of shattered aeon stones that crackle with electricity.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (trained) to remove one nexus aeon stone from the center
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap loses one action each turn for each nexus aeon stone removed from its center. On each action, it shoots a jet of electrified, razor-sharp aeon stone shards at a different creature within 30 feet, dealing 1d8+3 piercing damage and 1d8+3 electricity damage (basic Reflex DC 23).

agitated-carnivorous-plants.fuente: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
agitated-carnivorous-plants.descripcion: Many carnivorous plants that were once kept satiated now hunger for any meat they can get, even lashing out onto the path to get it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 25 (trained) to distract or trick the plants or Nature DC 22 (expert) to calm the plants

anguished-tombstone-door.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
anguished-tombstone-door.descripcion: A malfunction in the door's opening mechanism has caused unstable magic to pool within it, making it liable to release the sorrows it has collected from all who have mourned their lost homeland at its threshold.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 (expert) or Deception DC 26 (trained) to coax the door's magic into allowing access; the DC is reduced by 2 if someone in the room has said "Tar Khadurrm" in the last hour.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

augmented-azlanti-elemental-nexus-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-02: The Blackwood Lost
augmented-azlanti-elemental-nexus-5-6.descripcion: A large cylindrical metallic structure surrounded by dense cables and pipes, anointed with mystical runes which glow and hum vibrantly. Elemental energy arcs off three spikes that may have once been connected to some of the cables.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 23 (trained) to restart the machine's connection to an elemental plane, or Thievery DC 26 (trained) to find and deactivate the whichever rune is currently active; three total successes are required to disable the nexus. A spike can be disabled with a Athletics DC 26 (trained) check to rip it from the structure or a Crafting DC 23 (trained) check to reconnect some of the cables. If all 6 elemental energies are returned to the nexus, it is disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The nexus spends each of its actions making an elemental wave Strike; each of these must be against a different creature who does not have the elemental trait. For each spike destroyed or disabled, the trap loses 1 action.

averlace-s-last-stand.descripcion: Averlace's lingering sentiment wards her mentor's remains and her own.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 18 (trained) to exorcise the haunt, or Deception DC 20 or Diplomacy to convincingly say Garmon is "safe"
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets every night at midnight until the skeletal soldiers risen from Garmon and Averlace are destroyed.

bee-induced-panic.descripcion: Enraged bees spread panic, causing the crowd to trample each other in a desperate attempt to escape.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 22 (expert) to calm the panicked crowd and guide them to safety, Medicine DC 20 (trained) to attend to victims' injuries, or Nature DC 21 (expert) to instruct the crowd on how best to protect themselves from bees. Alternatively, a PC able to communicate with insects can instead attempt a Diplomacy DC 18 (trained) check to calm and redirect the bees. Three successful checks are required to completely disable the hazard. The hazard is automatically disabled after 5 rounds or once both swarms are defeated.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Panicked attendees suffer stings and accidentally injure one another in their fear and confusion. Increase the Casualties score by 1. This increases to  if one swarm is stinging the crowd, and it increases to  if both swarms are stinging the crowd.

blasphemous-blood.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
blasphemous-blood.descripcion: The walls and ceiling begin bleeding more and more, and gouts of cursed blood spew from both decapitated statues' necks.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 to exorcise the influence of Charg from a statue, Thievery DC 26 to dismantle the magical blood generator in a statue's neck, Dispel Magic (3rd-rank, counteract DC 20) to render a statue inert; each statue must be disabled separately
datos.rutina:
(2 actions) The hazard sprays a sizzling gout of cursed blood from the neck stumps of each of the defiled statues of Pharasma for each of its actions. If a statue is disabled or destroyed, the hazard loses that corresponding action. Each gout targets a randomly determined non-sahkil creature in area C13, who must then attempt a Reflex DC 22 save against the following effects. After dark, this trap gains 4 actions instead of 2, with each statue firing two gouts of blood. Regardless of how many gouts are fired, a creature can be targeted only once per round by these gouts.

—
Critical Success The target is unaffected.
Success The target takes 2d6 spirit damage.
Failure The target takes 2d8 spirit damage, 1d6 persistent damage, and is exposed to the curse of death's blood.
Critical Failure The target takes 4d8 spirit damage, 2d6 persistent damage, and is exposed to the curse of death's blood (and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to save against the curse).
datos.reinicio: The blasphemous blood deactivates at the start of any round in which no creatures other than a sahkil are in area C13, then resets after 3 rounds.

blooming-jijioa.descripcion: An invisible solar fare causes this patch of unassuming ground cover to suddenly bloom into a radioactive feld.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 22 (trained) to remove a 5-foot square of jijioa, or 5 points of fire damage to destroy an affected area
datos.reinicio: An hour after blooming, a jijioa patch goes dormant for 1 week.

breath-of-despair.descripcion: The faces carved on the wall appear to inhale, then exhale slithering tendrils of darkness to harm those who would despoil the tomb.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to disarm the trap's sensors in the chamber floor, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the faces. Breaking one of the faces on the walls reduces the trap's save DC, attack rolls, and its total actions by 1 per broken face; if all four faces are destroyed, the trap is disabled.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action per disabled face each turn. On each action, a different face spews a writhing breath of darkness from its mouth to a target in area C2. A creature can only be targeted once per round by the despairing breath, so if fewer than four creatures are in the room, the trap won't be able to take full advantage of all four of its actions.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 minute

calcite-seep.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves
calcite-seep.descripcion: A seep of mineral-rich water coats any unattended objects in a layer of calcite.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 20 (trained) to shatter the calcite using the resonant powers of the consonite crystals plus Athletics DC 20, Nature DC 20, or Survival DC 20 (trained) to dam the flow of water.

centipede-carcasses-trap.descripcion: Three giant centipede carcasses have wire springs that pull out and fling their sharpened legs around the room.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 23 (trained) to bend the centipede carapace so the wire can't pull out any more legs, or Thievery DC 21 (expert) to cut the springy wires. After all three carcasses are disabled (regardless of the check used), the trap is deactivated. The trap automatically deactivates after 10 rounds.
datos.rutina: (1 action) Each creature within 30 feet of a centipede carcass that hasn't been disabled takes 6d4 piercing damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save).

cleansing-pool.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-16: The Heart of the City
cleansing-pool.descripcion: The swirling water in this pool entices anyone who can see or hear it to wander into its depths, drowning its victims.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 24 to scratch out the runes creating the effect, Occultism DC 20 (expert) or Demon-lore DC 20 (expert) to determine the password that identifies the party as believers, or Dispel Magic (3rd-rank; counteract DC 22); two total successes are required to deactivate the pool.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; mental) The cleansing pool uses its first action to try and compel all creatures within 5 feet to enter into the pool. Creatures must attempt a Will DC 20 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is immune to the pool's routine for 1 minute.
Success No effect.
Failure The creature gains the Fascinated condition and attempts to enter the pool.
Critical Failure As failure, but the creature must also use all of their actions on their next turn to try and pull one of their allies into the pool with them.

collapsing-barricade-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-11: Flames of Rebellion
collapsing-barricade-3-4.descripcion: A tunnel through this steep barricade is rigged to collapse. If a kobold spends one action to throw a lever, the tunnel collapses on the next creature to pass through.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) to carefully trigger the collapse without entering the tunnel.

consonite-needles.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves
consonite-needles.descripcion: Consonite forms needle-like stalactites that can easily break free if touched, setting off a chain reaction that threatens to pierce anyone who stands in the area.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 20 or Thievery DC 20 (trained) to Squeeze or reach carefully through the gaps between the needles.

darkened-shadow-cannon.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-08: Battle for Star's Fate
darkened-shadow-cannon.descripcion: A cannon built of cast iron and infused with shadow magic, mounted on the side of Aslynn's flying ship.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 23 or Thievery DC 23 on the cannon's body to deactivate
datos.rutina: (1 action) The cannon fires a blast that contains as many PCs as possible, choosing randomly in the event of a tie.

darkened-shadow-cannon-4-17.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-17: Trapping the Hag's Claw
darkened-shadow-cannon-4-17.descripcion: A cannon built of cast iron and infused with shadow magic, mounted on the side of Aslynn's flying ship.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 24 or Thievery DC 24 to disrupt the cannon; two checks are required to disable it
datos.rutina: (three actions) The cannon fires a blast that contains as many PCs as possible, choosing randomly in the event of a tie, then reloads.

deadly-workshop.descripcion: Swinging bladed chains whip through the entire workshop.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (expert) on the control panel on the raised platform deactivates the trap.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap swings one slashing blade against every creature in the workshop as 1 action. The entire workshop is treated as difficult terrain because of the sheer number of slashing chains. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

death-drop-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-04: To Seek the Heart of Calamity
death-drop-5-6.descripcion: An invisible force shoves creatures backwards, hurling them through the chamber's doorway.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 23 (trained) to disperse the force or Religion DC 21 (trained) to hide from the ominous presence's senses
datos.reinicio: 1 day

death-s-slumber-ward.descripcion: A whirlwind of four ephemeral, magical threads dispels the undead and shrouds the living in an endless slumber.

datos.desactivar:
Religion DC 23 (expert) or Performance DC 21 (trained) to dissipate one of the four threads. Characters who failed or critically failed a Performance check to participate in Grandfather Eiwa's funeral in Chapter 1 have been able to reflect on the experience; these characters gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their Performance checks to disable this trap.

The trap is destroyed when all four threads are dissipated.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) Each thread of energy passes through a random living or undead creature within 60 feet, dealing 4d6 damage (basic Will DC 22) to the creature. A thread deals 4d6 void damage to living creatures and 4d6 vitality damage to undead creatures. Each thread passes through a different random creature, if possible. Each dissipated thread reduces the trap's number of actions by 1.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after no living or undead creatures are within 100 feet, then resets.

deep-quicksand.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-04: To Seek the Heart of Calamity
deep-quicksand.descripcion: A 15-foot-wide patch of water and sand attempts to submerge creatures that step onto it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 21 (trained) to disturb the surface
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the quicksand pulls down each creature within it. A creature that was submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and has to hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature in the quicksand can attempt a Athletics DC 23 check to Swim to either raise itself by one step if it's submerged to its neck or worse, or to move 5 feet if it's submerged only up to its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step.

A creature that Swims out of the quicksand escapes the hazard and is prone in a space adjacent to the quicksand patch. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar aid, or attempt to pull the creature out with their own Athletics DC 23 check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check.
datos.reinicio: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 24 hours.

deeply-flawed-ritual.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
deeply-flawed-ritual.descripcion: A flawed ritual emits surges of shadowy energy and opens tiny breaches into the Shadow Plane.

datos.desactivar:
Seven flaws have appeared in the ritual circle, dancing like shadowy flames. Each of Tavvar's three aides keeps one flaw under control as long as they are alive, while Tavvar herself staves off the ritual's implosion as listed in the ritual anchor ability below.

Each flaw can be repaired with a successful Occultism DC 24 check or DC 20 (trained) check using a skill related to the flaw's original cause (see the table below). Regardless of success or failure, a PC who attempts an Occultism check to disable the hazard learns the cause of the flaws and the skills that can be used to overcome it.

Each success on a check to repair a flaw using these other skills reduces the DC of the Occultism check to repair a flaw by 2. Instead of using skill checks, the PCs can use force to stabilize the ritual. A PC who defeats a shadow wisp automatically repairs one flaw.

d4
Cause of Flaw
Skills to Overcome

1
Harried (a "publish or perish" culture at the College of Mystery led to Tavvar cutting corners in the ritual's execution, so some runes aren't drawn quite right)
Arcana DC 20 (trained) or Thievery DC 20 (trained)

2
Misplaced Affection (Tavvar is from Nidal and subconsciously hopes the ritual will show that there is some good in her homeland; she included some Shadowtongue in the runes and it's enhancing the energy
Society DC 20 (trained) or Religion DC 20 (trained)

3
Cloistered (Tavvar hasn't done much field work and made a dangerous mistake in which mushrooms she used in the ink for the runes)
Crafting DC 20 (trained) or Nature DC 20 (trained)

4
Restrained (Tavvar's own hesitation and self-doubt has led to the ritual slipping out of her control)
Deception DC 20 (trained) or Diplomacy DC 20 (trained)
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On each of its turns, the ritual lets out a surge of shadowy energy, dealing 4d6 void damage (basic Fortitude DC 22 save) to each character who participated in ritual the past round (including Tavvar and her aides as well as any PC who attempted a skill check to disable the hazard). A non-participant can step in front of a participant as a reaction. This blocks the damage from the ritual caster, but the non-participant must then attempt the Fortitude save.
In addition to dealing damage, the ritual's surge of energy brings a Greater Shadow Wisp into the room. Wisps act at the end of the ritual's turn. If there are already two shadow wisps in the room, instead of creating a new wisp, the ritual restores 10 healing Hit Points to each wisp.

demon-ark.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
demon-ark.descripcion: A demonic presence animates the ship carrying demon pirates.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 (trained) to ward against demonic presence, Arcana DC 23 (trained) or Occultism DC 23 (trained) to weaken the demonic possession, Intimidation DC 23 (trained) to scare it away, or Sailing-lore DC 21 (trained) to confuse it; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina:
2 The demon ark uses its actions on one of the following options (GM's choice). It loses one action from its routine if a PC succeeds at an attempt to Disable it or it reaches its Broken Threshold.
• Broadside Blast a The demon ark makes a Chthonian cannon Strike.
• Demonic List d Effect The ship tosses and turns. Each creature in the hazard's area must make a Reflex DC 22 save. On a failure, it is knocked Prone; on a critical failure it also takes 4d8 bludgeoning damage.
• Heads Will Roll a It makes a bowsprit Strike.
• Sea Chantey a (auditory) All fiends within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects; all non-fiends within 60 feet must succeed at a Will DC 20 save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

—
Effect: Sea Chantey

despair-is-thy-reward.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
despair-is-thy-reward.descripcion: The ghosts of weeping, cowardly soldiers and the sound of claws scraping on the outer walls manifest.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 26 (trained) to stand firm against the coming terrors and show no fear or Religion DC 23 (expert) to exorcise the haunt; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action) The sound of talons scratching on the outer walls of the room and glimpses of lean, shadowy shapes flapping and scrambling at the arrow slits manifest. A PC who takes an action to  these shapes and succeeds at a DC 21 Occultism check to  recognizes the shapes as nightgaunts. Each round on its turn, these shadowy nightgaunts reach impossibly long, thin, spade-tipped tails into the room through the arrow slits or down the stove's chimney to make a shadowy tail Strike against every creature in the room as 1 action. If the door to this area remains open, the tails have an easier time reaching inside and gain a +2 circumstance bonus on their attack rolls.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates and then resets after 1 round in which no living creatures are within the watch post.

devil-s-breath.descripcion: The taxidermy monster lurches forward, howls, and exhales a blast of foul-smelling smoke.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 to pluck out the taxidermy's gemstone eyes
datos.reinicio: The Devil's Breath resets automatically after an hour.

dragged-to-the-briny-depths.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door
dragged-to-the-briny-depths.descripcion: A giant squid rams the ship from below, using its beak to puncture the hull. It then wraps its tentacles around the mast, rocking the ship violently.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 23 to pull the tentacles from the mast, stopping the ship from rocking; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (two actions) On its initiative, the squid uses its first action to pull on the mast Every creature must attempt a Reflex DC 22 save On a failure, it falls Prone If a creature is prone when attempting the save, it slides 10 feet in a direction determined by the GM on a failure If this movement would force a creature off the ship, it can attempt to Grab an Edge The squid uses its second action to make one tentacle attack
datos.reinicio: The squid releases the ship for one round before regripping the mast and resetting the hazard The hazard no longer resets once the PCs defeat the naiads or they flee

dragon-s-death-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-01: Citadel of Corruption
dragon-s-death-3-4.descripcion: The pile of bones transforms into a Large silver dragon, while the PCs appear to transform into dark, shadowy figures of alien physique. The dragon's flesh appears to slowly dissolve into lines of black smoke, which trail away toward the PCs and appear to be absorbed into their bodies. Once the dragon is stripped of flesh, its skeleton explodes in a shower of bone fragments.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 (trained) to exorcise the spirit (two actions), or Diplomacy DC 26 (trained) to calm the spirit momentarily (two actions).
datos.rutina:
Trigger A creature comes within 15 feet of the dragon skull

—

Effect All living creatures within 20 feet of the nest are peppered with bone shards and take 4d8+10 slashing damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save).

On a critical failure, the creature is Blinded for {1d4 hours}.
datos.reinicio: 1 minute, as the bone fragments slowly move back into a neat pile with the skull on top.

echoes-of-earthfall.descripcion: Bodiless screams arise as the room rumbles and shakes, as if in the grip of an earthquake.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 (expert) to exorcise the spirits or Intimidation DC 23 to stand resolute and show the spirits there's nothing to fear; three total successes are required to disable this haunt.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; illusion, mental) A thunderous explosion rocks the room as the ceiling appears to split open and collapse. This cave-in is an illusion formed from the memories of the dead, but it can inflict real damage. All creatures in the room must attempt a Will DC 22 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes 1d10 mental damage.
Failure The creature takes 1d10+6 mental damage and believes the room is filling with rubble—they're Slowed 1 until the start of their next turn as they spend their energy navigating the illusory rockfall.
Critical Failure The creature takes 2d10+12 mental damage and believes they're pinned by rubble—they're Immobilized until the start of their next turn.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates once no living creatures are in the cave at the end of a round, then resets 1 hour later as the spiritual energy rebuilds to a breaking point.

ectoplasmic-grasp.descripcion: A massive ectoplasmic hand forms around a creature and squeezes it.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 24 (trained) to send the ectoplasm back to the Ethereal Plane or Acrobatics DC 26 to move through and disrupt the coalescing ectoplasm before it takes hold
datos.reinicio: 1 day

eloise-s-last-gasp-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-02: The East Hill Haunting
eloise-s-last-gasp-3-4.descripcion: An obscuring fog covers the entirety of the hallway and northern room of the manor's second floor. Anyone moving through the area is subjected to an attack from a ghostly assailant.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 23 to maneuver through the fog, Religion DC 21 to ward off the spirit, or Stealth DC 23 to move through the fog without attracting attention. Disabling the haunt requires two successful checks, and each attempt takes two actions.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The haunt uses an action to manifest an illusory shadow beside a creature ending its move in the fog, then attempts a spectral touch Strike against that creature. The shadow disappears after the Strike.
datos.reinicio: The haunt lasts until disabled. It re-forms after 1 hour unless Eloise's ghost is put to permanent rest.

enchanted-sweets.descripcion: The enchanted pile of cookies and pastries arranged in this tasteful display case emit a supernaturally delicious aroma that compels those who fall under its smell to eat, eat, eat. No matter how many are consumed, the case always fills with more.

datos.desactivar: Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20); destroying the case and its contents also shatters the enchantment and prevents further compulsion or poisonings.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On the hazard's turn, if any creature is within the range of eatable enticement that is neither compelled by nor immune to it, the enchanted sweets target that creature with the same effect. Otherwise, it targets all creatures who have consumed some of its contents with a gut-rotting magical poison. Any creature who has consumed some of the enchanted sweets takes 2d12 poison damage with a basic Fortitude DC 22 save.

enraged-sea-life.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door
enraged-sea-life.descripcion: A swarm of aggressive cuttlefish, octopuses, devil rays, and countless other species of sea life bite and bludgeon Timonithaea's enemies.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) to remove the crown from the altar while avoiding being bitten by the swarming sea life; or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to disable the crown's enchantment, breaking Timonithaea's control over the sea creatures.
datos.rutina: (one action) The sea creatures attack, dealing 1d8+3 bludgeoning,1d8+3 piercing damage to each creature hostile to Timonithaea within the temple (basic Reflex DC 22 save).

entrapping-chair.descripcion: A chair on concealed tracks surges forward, knocking a creature into the chair's seat and trapping them in place with clamping armrests.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to disrupt the tracks
datos.reinicio: The trap resets automatically over 2 rounds if the chair is unoccupied.

eternal-hall-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
eternal-hall-5-6.descripcion: Time distorts along this hallway, making the air feel like sludge.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) to disrupt the temporal distortions, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 21) to disperse the temporal energy

final-flight.descripcion: A creature experiences the death of a priest carried off by griffons and fed to their chicks.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 22 (trained) to soothe the restless spirits, or Religion DC 24 (trained) to recite a prayer honoring the deceased; two successful checks are required to disable the haunt
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the Lea of Honored Souls. Ten minutes after deactivating, the haunt resets.

fireball-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-09: Killer in the Golden Mask
fireball-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the rune

fires-of-abraxas.descripcion: Beams of fire lance out of the flames within the Sihedron to sweep through the room unless a prayer to Abraxas is uttered in Thassilonian.

datos.desactivar:
Thievery DC 23 to deface one of the small trigger runes on the walls, or Religion DC 23 to overwhelm the trap with prayers to a good deity

Bypass Prayers to Abraxas are carved into the walls in Thassilonian; speaking one of the prayers deactivates the trap for 1 hour.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets automatically after 1 hour.

flensing-trap-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
flensing-trap-5-6.descripcion: Rotating blades extend from the walls, floors, and ceiling of the surrounding halls when weight is removed from the trapped floor tile.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to disable the pressure plate
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 15 minutes.

flesh-for-the-hollow-star.descripcion: The flesh and leather sculpture of Azathoth seems to ripple and churn before eyes open across its surface—eyes that then open into mouths that extend long whipping tendrils of rasping filaments to bless with warped flesh.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 twice to pull away one of the two primary anchor points for the sculpture to cause the leather and bones to slump harmlessly to the floor, Religion DC 26 from a worshipper of a lawful or good faith to banish Azathoth's influence from the hazard, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank, counteract DC 20) to counteract the hazard
datos.rutina:
(2 actions; necromancy, occult) The eyes open like mouths to extrude a whipping tangle of filaments that lash out at a target in area F19 or within 10 feet of any entrance into the room. The filaments can't attack a single target more than once per round. A creature targeted by a filament must attempt a Fortitude DC 22 save. The body of a creature slain by poison damage from this hazard melts into a heap and then splits open to allow a gibbering mouther to slither free; this creature attacks any non-worshipper of Azathoth it sees, or otherwise slithers off to area F20 to splash and gyre in the waters of the lake.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d6 poison damage.

Failure The creature takes 2d6+7 poison damage and becomes Enfeebled 1 as their flesh and muscles grow limp and saggy.

Critical Failure As failure, but 4d6+14 poison damage and Enfeebled 2.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets after a worshipper of Azathoth spends 1 hour in prayer before it.

flying-guillotine.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
flying-guillotine.descripcion: An invisible magical glyph on the guillotine's blade detects living creatures in the room, which causes the guillotine to fly off its hinges and attack.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (trained) to erase the glyph (which requires a successful unarmed attack roll if the blade is already active) or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract it. The trap has a secret bypass known only to Ralso and Pratchett: as long as the guillotine can see a creature in the room touching thumb and pinky together with an empty hand, it remains dormant.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The blade Flies up to 20 feet and Strikes any creatures whose squares it passes through. It cannot target the same creature more than once per round. The blade cannot be grabbed and doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: After 1 minute, the trap deactivates, though the door remains locked. The trap rearms itself each day at dawn.

footsteps-of-legends.descripcion: The characters witness Burning Mammoths walking this mountain pass in ages long past.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 26 (trained) to convince the spirits to remain dormant, or Religion DC 26 (trained) to ritually silence the spirits
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

gas-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
gas-trap.descripcion: A spring slams and locks the room's door before four hidden gas vents begin pumping poison gas into the chamber.

datos.desactivar: Four Thievery DC 20 checks to block the gas vents, or a Thievery DC 26 check to unlock the door and escape
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more toxic gas into the room.

Any breathing creature in the room takes 4d6 poison damage (a successful Fortitude DC 22 save halves the damage taken). If a creature acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone taking damage from the trap-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the creature's lungs is already tainted. Locating and blocking one of the hidden gas vents reduces the poison damage by 1d6-if all four are blocked, the trap is disabled, though the door remains locked. Otherwise, the trap functions for 1 minute before all the gas is expended and characters in the room cease taking damage, after which the trap ventilates the room for 1 additional minute.
datos.reinicio: The trap must be manually rearmed by unblocking the vents or replacing the poison gas tank in area E30.

gloomglow-mushrooms.descripcion: A field of grass-like fungal filaments amid clusters of softly glowing, long-stalked mushrooms.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 22 (expert) to remove a 5-foot-patch without triggering the mushrooms.

goh-s-shame.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
goh-s-shame.descripcion: A strange shadowy figure churns in the waters at Goh's feet.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 21 to calm Goh enough that the haunt dissipates, Religion DC 23 to exorcise the haunt, or Intimidation DC 25 to "scare the shame" out of Goh
datos.rutina:
(2 actions; emotion, fear, incapacitation, mental, occult) The haunt uses its first action to grapple with Goh and attempts to pull him underwater. Goh has a Fortitude DC of 19. In order to pull Goh underwater, the haunt must critically succeed at its grapple check against him with a result of 29 or higher to successfully restrain Goh. Goh is overwhelmed by terror and makes no attempt to escape, so it falls to the PCs to get him free from the haunt. If Goh is Restrained and pulled underwater, the haunt must continue to grapple him in following rounds. If the haunt manages to critically succeed at grappling Goh while he's restrained, the man dies from a combination of fright and drowning, at which point the haunt immediately ends. If Goh is pulled free and taken out of the water, the haunt loses one action and no longer attempts to grapple him. The haunt uses its second action to manifest the image of a drowned ghost, causing one creature it targets within 30 feet to attempt a Will DC 22 save (the haunt always targets a creature who attempted to free Goh from its grip if possible).

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is Frightened 1.
Failure The creature is Frightened 2 and Fleeing for as long as it remains frightened.
Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 3 and fleeing as long as it remains frightened, or for 1 minute, whichever comes second.
datos.reinicio: The haunt ends if Goh dies and doesn't reset. If Goh is dragged out of the water, the haunt ends at the end of its next turn but resets immediately the next time Goh enters the river.

grasping-dead.descripcion: Hands of the buried dead rise from the ground, grabbing and tearing at creatures in the area to drag them underground.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 22 (trained) to ritually pray for the dead or Occultism DC 24 (trained) to exorcise the spirits' anger; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action) The grasping hands batter all creatures in the area, dealing 2d6+7 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 26 save). On a critical failure, a creature is dragged partially into the earth, becoming Immobilized until it {Escapes}. If already immobilized, it's fully submerged and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.

grieving-carved-mourner.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
grieving-carved-mourner.descripcion: The carving weeps. Its tears turn to a mist that covers the halls.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 (trained) to recite prayers for the dead, or Dwarven-lore DC 20 to speak the history of Raseri Kanton, or Thievery DC 26 (trained) to plug the holes in the carving
datos.reinicio: The trap resets whenever a creature enters the Labyrinth for the first time.

hallways-full-of-even-more-mostly-illuso.nombre: Hallways Full of Even More Mostly Illusory Opossums
hallways-full-of-even-more-mostly-illuso.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-16: Dacilane Academy's First Great Prank War
hallways-full-of-even-more-mostly-illuso.descripcion: Several distressed opossums dressed in school uniforms and under the effects of Mirror Image fly about the hallway, guided by four giggling sprites.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 23, Deception DC 23, or Intimidation DC 23 four times to convince one sprite to undo their spells; Athletics DC 25, Diplomacy DC 25 (with wild empathy) or Nature DC 25 to subdue or soothe the opossums; or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 21) to undo one sprites' worth of spells. Four successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The hazard loses 1 action each turn for each Disable success. Each sprite takes one action to Strike a different randomly chosen PC.

hidden-pressure-plate.descripcion: A hidden pressure plate causes the secret doors to areas C2a to open.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 to render the pressure plate nonfunctional, or Perception DC 26 to locate a Hidden switch near the doors to area C3 that deactivates the pressure plate

house-spirits-with-an-absurd-number-of-r.nombre: House Spirits With an Absurd Number of Regenerating Pies
house-spirits-with-an-absurd-number-of-r.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-16: Dacilane Academy's First Great Prank War
house-spirits-with-an-absurd-number-of-r.descripcion: A group of house spirits run around the lunchroom hurling pies at the walls and all the people in the room—and then the pies magically reconstitute and throw themselves again.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 23, Deception DC 23, or Intimidation DC 23 four times to convince the spirits to undo their spells, Arcana DC 21 or Occultism DC 21 to unravel a pie's enchantments, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to undo one pies' worth of spells. Three successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The hazard regenerates any pies that it has thrown at a cost of one action per pie (to a maximum of 4 active pies). Each successful check to disable the hazard deactivates one of the pies, reducing the number of active pies by 1. After regenerating pies on its turn, the hazard throws pies whenever a creature triggers continually sur-piesed. For each pie Strike, roll 1d4. On a 1, the pie pan has nails driven into it by Numblekin and deals an additional 2d8+7 piercing damage. The nails make the pie's damage lethal, rather than nonlethal.

ice-prison-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
ice-prison-trap.descripcion: Magical sensors trigger clockwork cryomisters to expel frigid air, freezing intruders and potentially encasing them in a block of ice.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (expert) to disable the cryomisters, or Arcana DC 24 (expert) to trick the magical sensors, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the sensors
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its turn, the trap fills the area with frigid air, which deals 2d8+7 cold damage to creatures in the area. Creatures damaged must attempt a Fortitude DC 22 save. Clockwork soldiers and any creatures wearing a security badge are immune to this damage. The accumulating ice causes the floor in the area to become difficult terrain that lasts for 1 minute after the trap's routine ends.

—
Critical Success The target is unaffected.
Success The target takes half damage and increases its Slowed condition by 1.
Failure The target takes full damage and increases its slowed condition by 1.
Critical Failure The target takes double damage and increases its slowed condition by 2.

—
Once a creature's actions are reduced to 0 by this slowed condition, the creature is completely encased in ice. The ice has Hardness 5 and 20 Hit Points, and its DC to Force Open is DC 22. Breaking the ice frees the creature and reduces their slowed condition by 1. Each round a creature is encased in ice, they take 1d8+7 cold damage (basic Fortitude DC 22 save).
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 10 minutes.

in-a-right-pickle.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-01: Intro to the Year of Battle's Spark: Enough is Enough
in-a-right-pickle.descripcion: A soot-blackened brazier glows with fiendish light, shadows fickering inside.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 21, Occultism DC 21, or Religion DC 21 while within 15 feet of the brazier to command it to stop, reducing its actions by 1 (or 2 on a critical success); Thievery DC 23 to find the hidden switch on the brazier that deactivates it; or 1st-rank spell, counteract DC 20, to dispel the shadow flames in one square, using any spell with the water or light traits
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap ignites shadowy flames in a 5-foot square within the area of the room. A creature that moves into or ends its turn in this fire takes 2d6+5 fire damage (basic Fortitude DC 19 save). Increase the DC by 2 if the creature is in magical darkness (basic Fortitude DC 21).
datos.reinicio: The flames cease 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area, but after 1 hour, a well of darkness fills the brazier and it is ready to trigger again.

inexorable-door.descripcion: A recessed mechanism slowly pushes two iron doors closed, holding them in pace for 24 hours.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (expert)

intense-treacherous-scree.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-16: The Heart of the City
intense-treacherous-scree.descripcion: The footing on this sloped ground appears to be stable at first glance, but the tiny rocks that cover it are loosely packed and prone to slipping.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 23 (trained) to navigate a safe path

it-rains.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
it-rains.descripcion: Water splashes within an ornate 5-foot-tall amphora. The glossy exterior depicts images of a marid trapped in a cage of flames, the frightened creature waving their hands in warning.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 24 (trained) to scrape the flames away from the marid's image (requires two successes); Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 23) to disrupt the magical prison, disabling the trap for 10 minutes; or touch the amphora with Rayyan's seal to free the marid
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap has one action per round by default, though it may gain more actions based on the encounter's scaling as listed in the sidebar. On each of the trap's actions, the amphora pours out water, increasing the depth of the water by 5 feet. Once the room is full of water, creatures in the room begin drowning, and the trap deals 2d8+7 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude DC 22 save to each creature in the room on its action as the water pressure increases.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 2 minutes pass without a creature inside the room.

jona-s-nightmare.descripcion: A flood of blood bubbles up out of the ground, along with dozens of grasping arms that try to drag sleeping victims down into the gory deep.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 to draw upon your faith to weaken the haunt, Occultism DC 20 or Perception DC 26 to recognize tells that suggest this is all just a nightmare and to use lucid dreaming techniques to minimize the threat; three total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt tries to choke and drown the PCs in blood. The experience is harrowing and violent, and while the threat is all in the PCs' minds, it can still kill them. All affected PCs take 3d6 mental damage (basic Will DC 22 save). A PC who fails this saving throw also becomes Stupefied 1 for 24 hours (Stupefied 2 for 24 hours on a critical failure).
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates after 5 rounds. While the PCs then wake as detailed above, until the haunt is disabled, it resets and can trigger again the next time the PCs and Jona sleep.

lightning-platform-7-8.descripcion: A magnetically charged platform draws in armored creatures, then flings them up into the sky, where they are struck by lightning.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) to ground out the energy or Arcana DC 26 (expert) to neutralize the magical charge
