lured-to-ashes.descripcion: The illusory scene of a furnished study covers the room's actual appearance. It flickers and fades, revealing a scorched and burnt chamber. A moment later, the screams of burning victims fill the room, and blazing skeletal arms reach from the ashes and charred walls to scrape and claw.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 26 to command the spirits haunting this room to be silent or Religion DC 23 to exorcise the haunt
datos.rutina:
1 Action: If there are no targets within area B18 when the haunt takes its action, it can use its Lure reaction to try to get nearby victims back inside. The haunt manifests several burning skeletal arms that reach up from the ruined floors or out of the burnt walls to claw at every creature in area B18. These creatures must attempt a Reflex DC 22 save (creatures seated on a sofa take a -2 circumstance penalty to this saving throw).

—

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes 1d8 fire damage.

Failure The creature takes 2d8 fire damage and gains weakness 5 to fire. This weakness persists until the creature is fully healed.

Critical Failure As failure, but 4d8 fire damage and weakness 10 to fire.
datos.reinicio: 8 hours; destroying the tanglebones in area E3 destroys this haunt forever.

magic-starknives-trap.descripcion: Starknife symbols on the six pillars glow and shoot across the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (expert) or Dispel Magic on any four of the six pillars disables the entire trap (the trap is a 2nd-rank spell and the DC to dispel it is 21). Destroying any four of the six pillars also disables the trap.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) For each of its actions on its turn, a carving on a different pillar glows and makes a magical starknife Ranged Strike against a random creature within range. Creatures might have cover from this Strike, such as from one of the pillars in the room.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates 1 round after it has no target creatures and resets each day at sundown.

malevolent-reflections.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
malevolent-reflections.descripcion: Ornate full-length mirrors with fiendish filigree depict the image of Fasiel ibn Sazadin in villainous triumph over his enemies.

datos.desactivar: Stealth DC 27 (trained) to approach a mirror without showing up in the reflection, followed by Thievery DC 25 to cover mirror or dispel magic (3nd level; counteract DC 25) to counteract the binding

malfunctioning-annihilator.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall
malfunctioning-annihilator.descripcion:
A gargantuan scorpion-like robot, covered in signs of damage, has been bolted into the canyon's rock walls.

—

Integrated Chain Gun Hardness 10, HP 50 (BT 25) per integrated chain gun

Plasma Lance Hardness 10, Plasma Lance HP 26 (BT 13)

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to successfully disable the annihilator at the control box on the northwest ledge, Thievery DC 23 (trained) or Engineering-lore DC 18 to jam the mechanics of either of the two chain guns, or the "tail" mechanism where the plasma lance is mounted, preventing it from firing. Jamming the guns or tail require first getting on top of the immobilized annihilator, which counts as difficult terrain. All attempts take 2 actions.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) When the plasma lance is ready, the annihilator uses it to attack as many PCs as it can, otherwise it attacks with its two integrated chain guns while the plasma lance recharges, spending one action for each chain gun that is still functional. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty. If Synthetic Khismar is destroyed, the annihilator attacks as many creatures as possible.

memory-of-osoyo.descripcion: The party's memories of Osoyo coalesce into a titanic mirage in the storm clouds above.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 22 (trained) or Arcana DC 24 (trained) to divert the memory's rage; three total successful checks are required to disable the hazard
datos.rutina: (1 action) The memory of Osoyo gives a keening scream that shatters the layer of ice coating the deck of the Mermaid's Tears. Any creature on difficult terrain created by the memory's Glacial Gust takes 2d8+7 cold (basic Reflex DC 26) from the icy shrapnel.

middenworm-infestation.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
middenworm-infestation.descripcion: A dead body seems to ripple and bulge, as if something inside were shaking.

datos.desactivar: Medicine DC 23 or Thievery DC 26 to carefully cut into the corpse and vent the worms harmlessly in a safe direction

muesello-s-greater-summoning-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-11: No Time for Treason
muesello-s-greater-summoning-rune.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 21 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 23 (expert) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

myristica-s-despair.descripcion: The illusion shatters, revealing the grove to be a lifeless scar and the seemingly peaceful loggers to be crawling aimlessly about the clearing, consumed by rage and lashing out at anything that comes near.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 22 (trained) to tame the primal energy, Diplomacy DC 23 (trained) to console the dryad, Occultism DC 24 (trained) to identify and heal the emotional wounds; three successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; emotion, mental, primal) Myristica bemoans her grove's fate, overwhelming foes with sorrow. Each creature in the grove must attempt a Will DC 23 save.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Dazzled for 1 round and takes 2d6 mental damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes 2d6 mental damage, plus 2d6 persistent damage. While taking this persistent damage, they are dazzled.
datos.reinicio: Unless Silene is destroyed, this haunt can recharge itself after 1 hour.

overloading-arch-3-4.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
overloading-arch-3-4.descripcion: The Eternity Arch sparks with electricity, releasing bolts of lightning at each of the four largest time rifts.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) or Arcana DC 21 (trained), Nature DC 21 (trained), Occultism DC 21 (trained), or Religion DC 21 (trained) to seal each of the four time rifts, Crafting DC 23 (trained) to divert the lightning to another source, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract each time rift. Each attempt requires 2 actions. Skill checks to disable a time rift must attempted from adjacent to the rift.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled time rift. On each of the trap's actions, the Eternity Arch releases a bolt of lightning that activates that rift, dealing 2d8 electricity damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the time rift (basic Reflex DC 22 save). It can release a bolt at each active time rift no more than once each turn.

planar-cracks-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-16: Freedom for Wishes
planar-cracks-5-6.descripcion: The cracks scintillate and shift between the elemental planes, leaking perilous energy with each shift.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 24 (trained) twice to assemble a seal using objects strongly grounded to the Material Plane, Arcana DC 22 (trained) twice to invoke incantations to seal the cracks, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank, counteract DC 20) to counteract the cracks.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) A surge of energy strikes a random non-mephit creature in the foyer. Roll 1d4 to determine the element of the energy surge.

1-Energy from the Plane of Air: the creature takes 2d8 electricity damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save); on a failure, the creature is pushed back 10 feet toward the entryway. The hazard gains the air and electricity traits for this round.

2-Energy from the Plane of Earth: the creature takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save); on a failed save, the creature is knocked Prone. The hazard gains the earth trait for this round.

3-Energy from the Plane of Fire: the creature takes 2d8+7 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save). The hazard gains the fire trait for this round.

4-Energy from the Plane of Water: the creature takes 2d8 cold damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save); on a failed save, the creature's lungs fill with water, making them Sickened 1. The hazard gains the cold and water traits for this round.
datos.reinicio: The cracks re-form after 1 hour.

poisoned-lock-lionlodge.descripcion: A spring-loaded, poisoned needle is hidden near the drawer's keyhole. Disabling or breaking the trap does not disable or break the lock.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) on the spring mechanism.

precarious-footing.fuente: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
precarious-footing.descripcion: The ground around the lava pit is crumbling and unstable.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 18 (trained) to weather the collapse safely; Crafting DC 20 (trained) to stabilize the ground

precarious-sliding-floor.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
precarious-sliding-floor.descripcion: The floor wobbles with each step.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (trained) to prop up the floor, or Crafting DC 23 (expert) to reinforce subflooring
datos.reinicio: immediate

primal-chaos-aura.descripcion: Primal magic becomes unpredictable near areas where Agyra lairs, sometimes to hazardous effect.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 22 to negate the aura's effect for 1 round by temporarily drawing off the excess power and channeling it back into surrounding terrain, Nature DC 26 (expert) to completely disperse the lingering magic
datos.rutina: (2 actions) On its initiative, the hazard gathers primal energy from the surroundings as its first action. Roll  to determine the type of energy gathered. The hazard uses its second action to replicate the associated spell (2nd rank, DC 23, spell attack modifier +15). The spell's target or targets are chosen randomly from creatures in the area. Any spell cast by this hazard is primal. 1 air (Gust of Wind); 2 electricity (Thunderstrike); 3 fire (Blazing Bolt); 4 poison (Spider Sting); 5 sonic (Shatter); 6 water (Hydraulic Push)
datos.reinicio: The hazard deactivates and immediately resets if it has no targets for 1 round; it also resets if Agyra slumbers for 1 week within 100 feet.

prism-ray-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
prism-ray-trap.descripcion: Four magical prisms integrated into an aeon stone matrix fire energy beams at intruders. The trap doesn't target creatures wearing security badges, or in the custody of a creature wearing a security badge.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to disconnect one prism from the aeon stone matrix, or Arcana DC 21 (trained) to disrupt one prism's magical energy, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract one prism; four total successes are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) Each prism uses 1 action to make an energy ray Strike against the nearest creature who is not wearing a security badge or in the custody of a creature wearing a security badge. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty. This trap loses 1 action for each prism disabled or destroyed.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets when there are no viable targets in area A1. Damaged prisms are fully repaired after 24 hours.

protoplasmic-extruder.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-00: Origin of the Open Road
protoplasmic-extruder.descripcion: A spherical contraption of metal and reinforced hoses 20 feet in diameter, the protoplasmic extruder draws in the arcane slurry from Quantium's sewers and magically transforms the slurry into dangerous oozes.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 22 (expert) twice or Thievery DC 24 (expert) causes it to lose its action on its next turn. Two successes (or one critical success) disables it completely; Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) causes the protoplasmic extruder to lose its action on its next turn but never disables it.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the trap creates an ooze in an adjacent unoccupied space. The first time the protoplasmic extruder uses this action, it creates a Gelatinous Cube that acts immediately and thereafter acts on the protoplasmic extruder's initiative. In following rounds, the protoplasmic extruder instead creates Sewer Oozes that act in the same manner.

Oozes created by the protoplasmic extruder are a nacreous green color; a gelatinous cube loses its transparent ability. All oozes created by the protoplasmic extruder are loyal to the Ohrlavis and act as they command.

The protoplasmic extruder can create no more than four oozes in total before it deactivates and resets.
datos.reinicio: The protoplasmic extruder must gather reagents from the arcane slurry of the sewers for 24 hours before it can be reactivated.

punish-defiance.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
punish-defiance.descripcion: A magical mural threatens uncooperative inmates, causing mental trauma.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to deactivate the mural, or Arcana DC 26 (trained) to disrupt the mural's magic, or Deception DC 24 (trained) to pose as a superior and order the mural to deactivate, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the mural
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its turn, the trap threatens all living creatures in the room, dealing 3d6+5 mental damage (basic Will DC 22 save).
datos.reinicio: 1 hour.

ravenous-pit.descripcion: A seemingly ordinary hole in the forest floor exerts a strange gravity on creatures that come near.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 23 or Occultism DC 23 (expert) three times to disperse the unusual energy surrounding the hole, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the engulfing magic
datos.rutina:
(2 actions) For each action, the pit chooses a different creature within a 20-foot emanation to attempt to swallow. That creature must attempt a Fortitude DC 22 save. On a failure, the creature is pulled 5 feet closer to the hole (10 feet on a critical failure). If this would pull the creature into the pit, that creature can attempt to Grab an Edge as a reaction (DC 22). A creature who falls into the pit disappears into an extradimensional space that feels like being buried alive. A creature takes 2d8+7 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 20 save) at the end of each its turns in the extradimensional space. A creature in this extradimensional space is Grabbed and Slowed 1; they can Escape this extradimensional space with a successful Athletics DC 22, Nature, or Survival check. If they succeed, they appear in a random spot no more than 10 feet from the hole as if they had clawed their way from the dirt.
While this trap is active, all creatures treat movement away from the pit as difficult terrain.
datos.reinicio: If the trap isn't disabled, it becomes dormant for 10 minutes if there are no creatures within 20 feet of it at the start of its turn.

repeater-crossbow-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
repeater-crossbow-trap.descripcion: A pressure plate in the hallway floor releases a latch, causing a ceiling panel to drop down. A +1 striking heavy crossbow contained in a steel box sprays bolts at any creatures in the hallway.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 (Expert) or Crafting DC 20 (Trained) to disengage the reloading mechanism; the trap can also be disabled by the switch in area F2
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The repeater crossbow trap reloads (2 actions) then Strikes a random creature in the hallway.
datos.reinicio: The trap runs out of ammo after it fires 5 bolts; it must be manually reloaded.

riotous-mushrooms.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-12: Mischief in the Maze
riotous-mushrooms.descripcion: Giant mushrooms sprout from the ground, their caps reaching up to 15 feet high. Each giant mushroom flls up one 5-foot square and can appear anywhere within 20 feet of the center of the ring except adjacent to another giant mushroom. The ring can be disabled but not damaged before it activates.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 19 (trained) or Occultism DC 19 (trained) to repair the runes, Survival DC 23 (trained) to disturb the soil within the ring to weaken the mushrooms; one successful check to disable this hazard reduces the mushrooms' hardness to 0, and two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (two actions) A mushroom adjacent to one or more creatures uses Poison Spores. If there are no adjacent creatures, the mushroom vanishes in the ground and reappears in another square, making a Sprout attack. If no conscious creatures are within 20 feet of the center of the ring, the mushroom does nothing. A mushroom will not sprout underneath an Unconscious creature. Each mushroom only acts once.
datos.reinicio: The giant mushrooms start to wilt and disappear 1 minute after all conscious living creatures have left the area. After 1 hour, the magic recharges, and the hazard is ready to trigger again.

ritual-effects.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-14: Twice in Steel
ritual-effects.descripcion: The effects of Hesla's profane ritual ripple outward through Deskari's Gullet. Physical tremors shake the cavern complex, while magical waves of energy affect those opposed to her actions.

datos.desactivar: This hazard persists until Hesla's ritual is complete and her demonic forces defeated.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The ground shakes, and waves of demonic energy surge through the cavern. Each PC must make a save against tremors and a save against demonic energy. Enemy combatants must only make the Reflex save against tremors; they are immune to the Demonic Energy effects.

rockfall-ceiling.descripcion: A load of rocks, held up by a rope pulley, is dropped on the cavern's lower level.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) to pin the pulley in place

sailor-s-warning-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
sailor-s-warning-5-6.descripcion: An illusory cyclops in oracular robes cries out a warning, but then dissolves into a violent phantasmal cyclops, which calls out for the Blind Formless Chaos That Lies Behind the Stars to accept his sacrifice. It then plunges an obsidian athame into a creature's chest, summoning a foul entity.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 21 (trained) to repair Chamenaiti's magic, Religion DC 23 or Occultism DC 23 (trained) to offset the prayer, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 21) to counteract the warning
datos.rutina: a Rubbery crimson tentacles appear from a rip in the air and grasp at all creatures in the area, dealing 1d6+3 bludgeoning,1d6+3 acid damage (basic Fortitude DC 22 save).

sarracenia-s-ire.descripcion: The illusion shatters, revealing the grove to be a lifeless scar and the seemingly peaceful loggers to be crawling aimlessly about the clearing, consumed by rage and lashing out at anything that comes near.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 22 (trained) to tame the primal energy, Religion DC 24 (trained) to suppress the haunt, Diplomacy DC 25 (trained) to console the dryad; three successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; emotion, mental, primal) Sarracenia's rage overwhelms up to two living creatures in the grove, each of which must attempt a Will DC 23 save.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure For 1 round, the creature is confused, is Stupefied 1, and gains a +4 status bonus to damage rolls.
datos.reinicio: Unless Silene is destroyed, this haunt can recharge itself after 1 hour.

severing-trip-wire.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
severing-trip-wire.descripcion: Barbed wire stretches across the passageway at the perfect height to tear into ankles.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to detach the wire

shining-shooting-sphere.descripcion: A gilded armillary sphere spins in place, shooting jeweled stars and planets at intruders.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (expert) to disable the sphere from rotating or Dispel Magic (3nd rank; counteract DC 23) to remove the enchantment.
datos.rutina: (1 action) A jeweled planet shoots from the sphere, targeting a random creature within 30 feet. The creature takes 2d8+7 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save).
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature moving within range of its sensor.

singe-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
singe-5-6.descripcion: Singe's spirit lingers in the Whippoorwill's crow's nest, where it calls out warnings and shoots intruders.

datos.desactivar: Pathfinder-society-lore DC 23 (trained) to persuade Singe that you are Pathfinders or Religion DC 23(trained) to perform rites to lay Singe to rest; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: d Singe uses its first action(s) to make a long gun Strike against a random creature in the area. It uses its final action for Lookout's Warning. If the PCs successfully use Pathfinder Society Lore to Disable the haunt, Singe loses an action to make a long gun Strike.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

slamming-gate--pathfinder-208-hoof-cinde.descripcion: A pressure-sensitive floor panel causes a spiked door to slam down into place from the ceiling, skewering anyone caught underneath.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (trained) to jam either the floor panel or the associated winch

spitting-acid-bushes-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall
spitting-acid-bushes-7-8.descripcion:
Four techno-organic "bush"; structures featuring mini-acid pumps activate. The first lashes out with sharp "branches" as it activates, and then all of the bushes spit acid at movement nearby.

HP is 14 per bush with a BT of 7

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 or Engineering-lore DC 23 (trained) on each bush to collapse its acid pump into component parts (2 actions per bush).
datos.rutina: (3 Actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each bush disabled. On each of the hazard's actions, one of the functional pumps spits acid at a creature within range. The bushes sense movement, and they only target creatures that moved from their space on their most recent turn. This trap does not attack any single creature more than once per round. It does not take a multiple attack penalty.

sticky-greeter.descripcion: A taxidermy giant spider's abdomen opens up to spray the area in front of it with sticky webbing.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 to disable the pressure plate that triggers the sticky greeter.
datos.reinicio: The sticky greeters must be reset manually.

storm-wrought-chains.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
storm-wrought-chains.descripcion: Brightly polished copper chains rumble with distant thunder and statically charge the air.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) to release the lock, or Arcana DC 25 or Nature DC 25 (expert) to harmlessly release the storm's energy
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour.

strong-electric-latch-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-06: Struck by Shadows
strong-electric-latch-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune imprinted on a door latch releases a powerful electric discharge.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to scratch out the rune without allowing electricity to flow, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 21) to counteract the rune

subduing-gas-chamber.fuente: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
subduing-gas-chamber.descripcion: A mechanical sensor in the desk drawer releases a counterweight in the wall, which slams the door shut and opens the sleeping gas tank under the bed, allowing gas to fill the air-tight room with a hissing sound.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (Trained) to disconnect the wire to the counterweight, preventing it from falling, or Crafting DC 20 (Alchemical Crafting) to create a counteragent to the sleeping gas
datos.rutina: (1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more sleeping gas into the room. Any breathing creature in the room is exposed to the toxin. If a creature acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone breathing in the poison-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the creature's lungs is already tainted. The trap functions for 1 minute before all the gas is expended, after which it rapidly decays over the next minute. Opening the door to an adjacent room cuts the remaining time it takes for the gas to decay in half but exposes creatures in that room as well.
datos.reinicio: The gas must be manually reloaded.

summoning-rune-barbazu-devil.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
summoning-rune-barbazu-devil.descripcion: A summoning circle inlaid into the room's floor detects living creatures and summons a violent devil.

datos.desactivar: Perception DC 18 to notice the trap's magic and avoid stepping on the floor outside the circle, followed by Thievery DC 21 (trained) to break the circle or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

summoning-rune-cinder-rat.fuente: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
summoning-rune-cinder-rat.descripcion: An invisible cloud of magical sensors detects living creatures in the room and summons fire elementals to slay the creatures.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 22 (trained) to approach without triggering the trap, followed by Thievery DC 22 (trained) to erase the rune or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

the-sky-is-burning.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
the-sky-is-burning.descripcion: Fires suddenly spring up along the rafters of the exposed roof as strange, monstrous shapes can be glimpsed in the sky above, which is suddenly filled with smoke.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 26 (trained) to extinguish fires swiftly or Religion DC 23 (expert) to exorcise the haunt; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (4 actions) Ghostly figures flying in the skies above hurl bits of burning debris down into the three rooms of the schoolhouse below. The haunt uses its first three actions to target a random creature within the schoolhouse with a burning debris ranged Strike. A creature can't be targeted more than once per round—if there aren't enough targets for all 3 Strikes, the leftover Strike actions are wasted. On its fourth action, the haunt causes the fires in the building itself to flare up—all creatures inside the building take 2d8 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 21 save). These flare-ups are the most extreme in area A4a; creatures in areas A4b or A4c gain a +2 circumstance bonus on this Reflex save.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates and then resets after 1 round in which no living creatures are within the schoolhouse.

the-three-steps.descripcion: Beams of magical energy fire from the Sihedrons to fan the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 to trick the basket on the door handle into thinking it's got a proper bead inside it, or Stealth DC 18 each round to avoid being detected by the trap
datos.reinicio: Each trap resets automatically in 10 minutes.

thorns-of-the-rose-pit-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-12: The Burning of Greensteeples
thorns-of-the-rose-pit-5-6.descripcion: Decorated smooth-hewn flagstone flooring gives way along hidden seams to a 20-foot square, 25-foot-deep pit festooned with spikes and blades of petrified wood in the darkness below.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to disable the trap door mechanism
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trap door must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

tongues-of-flame.descripcion: Nozzles hidden in the ceiling of the four corridors leading to the intersection spray jets of flame along their lengths when the trap is triggered.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 to disable a single nozzle, Thievery DC 21 twice to unlock a door, or Thievery DC 25 to deactivate the trap from the control panel. A hero who isn't trained in Thievery automatically fails these checks.
datos.rutina:
(4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled nozzle. On each action, a different nozzle fires a jet of flame down a different corridor, dealing 3d6 fire damage to each creature in the first 10 feet of the corridor past the intersection (basic Reflex DC 22).

A creature standing in the corridor intersection can be hit by only one flame jet per round even if they're in the area of multiple flame jets. The creature attempts only one saving throw per round, but it takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its saving throw.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets after 10 minutes. After the trap is activated for the fourth time, it runs out of fuel and must be reset manually.

tough-titanic-flytrap.descripcion: On the surface, a titanic flytrap appears to be a patch of the more common flytrap plant, but beneath murky waters it hides a far larger set of jaws, reaching 10 feet across and reinforced with woody branches and lined with paralytic hairs.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 24 (trained) to mislead the flytrap's sense of weight and pressure
datos.reinicio: 1 hour (or longer, after a large meal)

trial-by-flame-trap.descripcion: Nozzles connected to reservoirs of alchemist's fire are hidden just under the packed dirt of the floor, ready to spew burning jets when deployed.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) to disable the nozzles or Arcana DC 26 (expert) or Occultism DC 26 (expert) to disable the nearby magical sensor
datos.reinicio: The trap resets when an operator at the maze console in area A13 pulls the associated lever. The trap can be reset only once per minute.

trial-by-ice-trap.descripcion: A hidden vent in the ceiling is attached to a reservoir of freezing alchemical reagents that can create a bone-chilling cloud.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) to jam the vent closed or Arcana DC 26 (expert) or Occultism DC 26 (expert) to disable the nearby magical sensor
datos.reinicio: The trap resets when an operator at the maze console in area A13 pulls the associated lever. The trap can be reset only once per minute.

trial-by-poison-trap.descripcion: A dart launcher embedded in the ceiling holds a cartridge of darts tipped with deadly poison.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (trained) to disable the launcher or Arcana DC 26 (expert) or Occultism DC 26 (expert) to disable the nearby magical sensor
datos.reinicio: The trap resets when an operator at the maze console in area A13 pulls the associated lever. The trap can be reset only once per minute.

tripartite-lock.descripcion: Three massive gears stand out amid a chaotic array of smaller gears that virtually make up the entire surface of a set of enormous double doors. Tiny slots at the center of each of the massive gears perfectly match the prongs that emerge from the converse of one of the clan's tripartite key amulets.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to jam the gears into place, preventing the trap from using Screaming Gears (and simultaneously jamming the door shut); a critical success unlocks the doors without the tripartite key
datos.reinicio: The trap ceases its grinding shriek at the end of the round and immediately resets.

vengeful-spirits.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-06: Lost on the Spirit Road
vengeful-spirits.descripcion: A cadre of evil spirits assails people's minds throughout the stretch of forest. The spirits first afflict their hosts with visceral images of their own deaths, then try to recreate their deaths by forcing their hosts to inflict similar wounds upon themselves. Creatures frightened by the haunt appear to have ephemeral masks with horns, tusks, and yellow eyes over their faces.

datos.desactivar: Two Occultism DC 26 or Religion DC 26 (trained) to exorcise the spirits. A creature can either inflict 4 mental damage to the haunt or permanently lower the DC of checks to exorcise the spirits 1 by succeeding at a Diplomacy DC 22 check to calm the spirits, a Nature DC 22 check to use kami-specific warding incantations, a Occultism DC 20 check to leverage obscure haunt lore, or a Religion DC 22 check to use a lesser exorcism. Any creature currently frightened by the haunt is a potential target for inflicting damage to the haunt; mental and vitality damage only affect such a host creature if they choose to be affected, while force or similar damage harms both the haunt and the host equally.
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) On its initiative, the haunt uses its first two actions to attempt to terrify a random target in its area that is not already Frightened. The target must attempt a Will DC 22 save.

—

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to this haunt for 24 hours.

Success The target is Frightened 1.

Failure The target is frightened 1. The value of the frightened condition does not automatically decrease by 1 at the end of each of the target's turns. Instead, the target can attempt a Will DC 18 save at the end of each of their turns to lower their frightened value by 1.

Critical Failure The target is Frightened 2. The value of the frightened condition does not automatically decrease by 1 at the end of each of the target's turns. Instead, the target can attempt a Will DC 18 save at the end of each of their turns to lower their frightened value by 1.

—

The haunt then spends an action to compels one of the creatures that it has frightened to harm itself with surrounding forest debris, its strength fueled by spirit possession. The creature must succeed at a Will DC 22 save or attempt to Strike itself during its turn as its first action, using the haunt's statistics below. Note that frightened applies equally to the creature's attack roll and AC, and therefore does not affect the accuracy of the attack.

very-haunted-hollows.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-99: Under the Eye of the Mantis
very-haunted-hollows.descripcion: The spirits of innumerable dryads and peaceful wood elementals, ripped from their bodies as they were turned into furniture, writhe and seethe, lashing out at both living and undead alike.

datos.desactivar:
Diplomacy DC 20 (trained), Nature DC 20 (trained), or Religion DC 20 (trained) to set the spirits to rest or Deception DC 23, Intimidation DC 23, or Occultism DC 23 to convince the spirits that their eternal rest is coming soon.
A PC may make a Strike against AC 19 to destroy a single table or chair in the room, this functions as a successful check to Aid another PC attempting to disable the haunt; two total successes are required to disable the haunt. If all of the tables and chairs are destroyed, the haunt is temporarily disabled until dawn of the next day.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The Haunted Hollows haunt uses one table flip Strike or two chair toss Strikes at random creatures in the area, favoring those who are trying to disable the haunt first. The table flip Strikes originate with any table in the room, destroying the table in the process. The chair toss Strikes originate with any chair or bar stool in the room, destroying that object in the process. If the haunt is not disabled, these objects reform and return to their original positions at dawn of the next day.

very-hexed-chest.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers
very-hexed-chest.descripcion: The magical runes glow at any attempt to open this chest.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 (trained) to safely scratch out the runes or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the runes.

void-font.descripcion: The font is hidden just under the water's surface. It spews foul brown sludge into the pristine waters, leaving them reeking and polluted as they move downstream. It can be reached without swimming, but not without getting wet.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 20 (trained) to draw upon the suppressed Primal energies of this place to cleanse the font, Religion DC 26 (expert) to suppress the void energies, Thievery DC 23 to undo the magic sigils allowing the font to operate; two total successes are required to disable the font.
datos.rutina: The void font uses its actions each turn to spew a single void geyser.
datos.reinicio: The void font deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

volatile-tidal-controls.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
volatile-tidal-controls.descripcion: Sigils carved into the turquoise sphere atop the altar illuminate. Moments later, a rush of water flows into the hallway.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 23 (trained) to neutralize the tidal magic, or Survival DC 26 to predict the changing tides, or Thievery DC 26 (trained) to scratch away the sigils; two total successes are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The magic controlling the tides malfunctions, causing the tides to change every few seconds. Water flows rapidly between areas B2 and B4. Each creature in area B2, area B4, or the hallway connecting them must attempt a Fortitude DC 22 save as the shifting tides buffet them, dealing 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 10 feet along with the water.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 20 feet along with the water.

weakened-floor.descripcion: A section of the cave floor collapses under a creature, plunging it 40 feet into a chasm filled with jagged stalactites.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 20 to knock loose the unstable floor and reveal a traversable ledge to the south.

writhing-hair.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
writhing-hair.descripcion: A ghostly woman floats quietly through the shop, plucking hair and sending it slithering into the rafters or out to infest uncooked steamed buns.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 23 to calm the upset spirit down, or Religion DC 21 to convince the spirit to abandon the haunting via prayer. If the PCs use Hinode Akari's name or otherwise let the haunt know that they understand her story, checks to Disable this haunt gain a +2 circumstance bonus.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt targets one creature in the shop at random, preferring targets who are Immobilized or Restrained. The ghostly figure moves over to the victim and begins to strangle them with coils of her hair while she begins clawing through the target's hair as if ripping it out by the handful. The target takes 2d8+7 mental damage (basic Will DC 22 save) from enduring the painful sensations of being strangled and having their hair plucked out, even though they're not actually being physically strangled or losing their hair.

accursed-cargo-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
accursed-cargo-5-6.descripcion: A wooden crate bearing a chthonic sigil glows with a power contained within it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) to open the crate with gradual release of its magical energy, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 21) to dispel the rune

acid-mist.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
acid-mist.descripcion: A golden guardrail sprays magical, flesh-eating acid throughout the stairwell.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to deactivate the trap's sensors, or Arcana DC 24 (expert) to disrupt the guardrail's magic, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the guardrail
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the trap continues to spray acid, dealing 2d8+9 acid damage to all living creatures on the stairs (basic Reflex DC 25 save).
datos.reinicio: The trap automatically deactivates after 1 minute. It resets in 1 hour.

acid-spray-fountain.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-00: Origin of the Open Road
acid-spray-fountain.descripcion: A concealed acid fountain with three nozzles is connected to eight pressure pads in the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) on the fountain stops it from spraying acid, or Thievery DC 22 (expert) disables one of the nozzles and reduces the number of actions the trap can take by 1. When the number of actions is reduced to 0, the fountain is disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) On its initiative, the trap makes an acid spray Strike against a random creature in the room for each of its actions.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates after 1 minute, at which point its acid reservoir is empty. It can't reactivate until this reservoir is refilled.

angry-dead.fuente: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm
angry-dead.descripcion: The faces of the original dwarven inhabitants of the city appear in the stone and scream in anger.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 (trained) to ritually pray for the dead or Occultism DC 25 (trained) to exorcise the spirits' anger; a dwarf succeeds at a Diplomacy DC 22 or Intimidate check, asking or ordering the spirits to stand down.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The faces continue to scream, dealing 5d6 sonic damage (basic Reflex DC 26 save) to all living creatures within 20 feet of the steps. On a critical failure, a creature takes double damage and is Deafened for 1 round. Deaf creatures are immune to this effect.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 round after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates. If the haunt is disabled by a dwarf succeeding at a Diplomacy or Intimidate check, the haunt is destroyed.

architect-and-hunter.descripcion: A ghostly pair of teenagers-the Xarwin twins-cry out in pain as their brains are replaced into their heads. As if their trauma reverses, the initial pain fades and they express the desire to play.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 21 (trained) to distract the haunt and entertain it until it becomes soothed or Religion DC 25 (trained) to exorcise the haunt
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The architect (Mira Xarwin) uses Shackled Memories to cause a strange, house-like cage of solid ectoplasm to spring up around a randomly determined target. This house bears an uncanny resemblance to the home the target grew up in. The hunter (Marney Xarwin) then attempts a hunting shot Strike at that target.
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets automatically 1 hour after it's defeated or after no living creatures remain in the area to play with. Removing Marney's and Mira's brains from the brain collector statue in area E9 destroys the haunt.

barzillai-s-hounds.descripcion: Hell hounds invisible to all but their lone target burn their chosen victim.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 24 (expert) to perform an exorcism (with 2 actions)
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The haunt uses its first action to Stride (Speed 60 feet), then its second action for a jaws Strike against its designated target if it is in reach. If the target is not in reach, the haunt resets.
datos.reinicio: If their designated target dies or the hounds can't reach it in a turn, the hounds vanish into noxious smoke, but they manifest again elsewhere in the city after the next sunset.

bellflower-chant.descripcion: A chorus of Bellflower Network agents and allies chant about freedom from tyranny.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 21 (trained) to join the chant, or Society DC 25 to identify the Bellflower agents' tactics
datos.rutina: (1 action) The Bellflower chant continues their song. All non–Bellflower Network creatures in area A must attempt a Will DC 26 save. On a failure, the target is offguard until the end of its next turn.

black-powder-bomb.descripcion: Three bulky kegs of black powder placed at key locations in the temple are triggered to explode in unison, causing the entire structure to collapse into rubble and slide partially down the cliff face.

datos.desactivar:
No special skills are required to disable this manually activated trap. As an Interact action, a PC can sweep aside some black powder to interrupt the fuse line, but this doesn't prevent Gerhard from activating a keg via blunderbuss. A keg that is removed from its position (either by being thrown over the cliff or merely carried away) retains its explosive potential, but as long as one of the three kegs are removed they no longer have the precise placement required to trigger a collapse-an explosion at this point merely inflicts fire damage in the appropriate areas but does not particularly damage the temple structure itself.

A keg's contents can be dispersed by scattering the gunpowder to the wind (most efficiently by pouring it over the cliff side) as a 2-action activity, or rendered permanently inert by pouring a gallon of water into the powder, inhibiting its explosive qualities. The kegs themselves can be destroyed with damage (note that the AC listed below for each keg takes into account the fact that Gerhard has wedged the kegs into nooks in the temple's stone flooring and walls), but note that any fire damage (including incidental fire damage from area effects like a fireball or Gerhard's blunderbuss) causes them to explode. At your option, other actions may be similarly effective at disabling this hazard.
datos.rutina: If Gerhard lights the black powder fuse, it burns at a speed of 10 feet each round; when the fuse reaches a keg 6 rounds later, the black powder bomb explodes. The bomb explodes immediately if he shoots a barrel with his blunderbuss.

blood-drain.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
blood-drain.descripcion: A tiny spark of Nin's will drains the blood from living intruders.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to vandalize the space, or Religion DC 24 (expert) to pray to a god for passage, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the magical energy
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the trap continues to drain blood, dealing 2d6+8 void damage to all living creatures in the room (basic Fortitude DC 26 save). On a failure, a creature increases the value of their drained condition by 1.
datos.reinicio: The trap automatically deactivates after 1 minute. It resets in 1 hour.

bloodletting-scythe-blade.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
bloodletting-scythe-blade.descripcion: Two blades, each hidden in a 15-foot-long ceiling groove, are connected to a trip wire.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 24 (trained) to disable each blade
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 15 minutes.

bloodletting-snare.descripcion: Slender razor wire snags a creature, hauling them up into the air while causing deep, bloody wounds.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 25 (expert) or Thievery DC 25 (expert) to snip the wire without getting snared

boreal-rage-trap.fuente: Pathfinder One-Shot #4: Mark of the Mantis
boreal-rage-trap.descripcion: A stuffed owlbear twists toward intruders and breathes a gust of frigid air.

datos.desactivar: Thievery (expert) on the owlbear's base
datos.reinicio: 10 minutes

breathless-thicket.descripcion: A 10-foot-wide patch of dead shrubs with wilted flowers steals the breath of the living.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 28 (expert) or Survival DC 28 (expert) to recognize the thicket for what it is and avoid it
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The breathless thickets patch attempts to Strike a creature in its reach. It then uses Suffocate if it has any creature Grabbed; otherwise, it continues to Strike.
datos.reinicio: The thicket goes back into hibernation 1 round after there are no more targets to Strike in its reach. It then remains dormant for 24 hours.

bring-dusk-to-dawn.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
bring-dusk-to-dawn.descripcion: Shadows rise up from the empty tub, creeping along the floor, walls, and celling to blot out light.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 25 or Nature DC 25 (expert) to burn out the shadowy influence through prayer or meditation, Arcana DC 28 or Occultism DC 28 (trained) to use magic to block the shadowy influence from being able to manifest at all; three successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) A shadowy figure rises up from the bath, resembling the upper torso of a demonic humanoid with glowing eyes. On its first action, the haunt sweeps its many arms through area A19, dealing 4d6 void damage on all living creatures in the area (basic Fortitude DC 21 save). On its second action, it either spawns an undead shadow from its mass, or it Sustains a currently spawned undead shadow; it can only have one shadow active at a time. This shadow has the minion trait, cannot leave area A19, and takes its two actions on the haunt's initiative. Void damage from the haunt doesn't heal a shadow minion.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates at the end of any round in which no living creature is in area A19, then resets 1 round later.

carrion-vortex.descripcion: The countless bones and feathers on the floor churn into the air in a clattering swarm of partially reconstructed skeletal birds, whose mournful song fills the area as surely as do their slashing beaks and talons.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 23 to convince the carrion vortex that the PCs pose no ill intent or Religion DC 20 to exorcise the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action; evocation, occult) The churning vortex of beaks and bones takes its action through area D2, clawing and pecking at any creature in the area. All creatures in area D2 take 2d8+9 slashing damage (basic Reflex DC 24 save).
datos.reinicio: 24 hours; defeating the corrupted psychopomps in areas D5 and E4 destroys this haunt forever.

cathilia-s-meddling.descripcion: A Hellknight on horseback shouts commands, beseeching all to return to order.

datos.desactivar: Hellknight Lore DC 21 (trained) to convince the Hellknight that she's adding to chaos, or Diplomacy DC 25 to request she stop yelling
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Cathilia uses her Hellknight's Orders Strike on creatures engaged in open fighting in area A2. She randomly chooses between targets in the likely case that there are multiple combatants.

clone-mirrors.descripcion: Two opposing mirrors spawn endless illusory duplicates of creatures in the hall.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) to reposition each mirror, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract each mirror
datos.rutina: (2 actions) This trap loses 1 action for each mirror disabled. Each mirror uses 1 action to Spawn a Reflection of a creature reflected in the mirror. The hazard can have a maximum of four reflections spawned at once.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 day.

collapsing-bridge--pathfinder-kingmaker.descripcion: As a pillar collapses, the bridge itself groans and shakes, then crumbles into the river below.

datos.desactivar: Several weeks of repair can rebuild the supports and remove the danger; at the GM's discretion, spells like Wall of Stone or Wall of Force can be used to augment the supports more quickly, although these spells are likely out of reach of the PCs at this point.

collapsing-ramp-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
collapsing-ramp-7-8.descripcion: Abyssal fire hits the stone beneath the ramp, causing a 15-foot-long section of it to collapse.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 28 (expert) to stabilize the masonry. Each attempt takes 2 actions.

corpselight-mist.descripcion: Churning vapors of glowing green mist fill a 30-foot-deep chasm.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 28 to counteract Kabriri's influence here by offering prayers to any non-evil deity and causing the mist to disperse, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the mist for 24 hours
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets automatically at the end of a turn and can trigger again the next round.

creatures-of-the-night.descripcion: Bats and rats swarm around Ezio's enemies.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 24 or Religion DC 24 (trained) to scatter the vermin; two successes are required to disable it
datos.rutina: (1 action) The bats and rats bite all creatures in the room, doing 2d8+3 piercing damage (basic Reflex DC 24 save). On a failure, the creature also takes 3 persistent damage.
